_doc: Engine forms of the Effects named Effects that items and techniques carry (design/items/catalogue-*.json, effects.md). fight.py adds an Effect's records when a build wears a piece naming it and the build file has not written its own 'eff:<Name>' records (a build's own version wins). Each entry: rule (the text it implements), records (engine Effects), optional static (lines folded into the build like item modifiers), reserve (share of linh luc reserved), count (compile-time multiplier: equipped items by role or by an art tag), approx (where the engine form is close but not exact), not_run (the rule needs a system the sim does not have). Units: dmg_more and cost_red are shares (0.15 = 15 %), L1-L5, crit, evade, healing, heal_taken and the other mods are points. Built 2026-11-13 from the hand-written forms in design/builds (harvested, conflicts resolved toward the rule text) plus new ones. Đạo Đồ Effects (source "Đạo Đồ", 2026-11-20; written by tools/design/dao_do_rework/content/tree_effects.py, which explains their fields): a build file names them in tree_effects. Extra fields: lines (plain stat lines, the closing numbers), count {of, cap} by a build count, fixed records (closings, never counted), pool_more, stack_alias, no_ward, only_tag, sheet_from, pending, engine_choice.

A Bite on the Line.rule: Ice Hook: while your Line Through the Ice holds a foe and you hold your Sitting in the Snow stance, each second they lose 1 % of their maximum linh lực to you, banked as Catch for Landing the Fish.

A Brimming Cup.rule: The Sweet Spring, full set: each heal you cast while above 80 % linh lực overflows into a stance ward worth 2.5 % of your maximum health (about half the heal). After holding full usable linh lực (overflowing each pulse) for 3 s, your next heal art gets +100 % healing.
A Brimming Cup.approx: Ward overflow runs on heal-tagged art firings above 80 % qi_share as a 2.5 % HP ward_grow (ward_grow scales by hp/peak rather than heal amount; 2.5 % matches ~half of Mai Lễ Tuyền's 4.2-4.9 % Hundred-Herb Draught heal); full-qi 3 s timer tracks consecutive overflow pulses and grants +100 additive healing to all heals while armed until the next heal-tagged art fires.

A Copy in Small.rule: The Small Morning, full set (3 pieces): each full plumage you spend gives you a ward worth 4 % of your health. While that ward holds, your plumage stacks build 25 % faster.
A Copy in Small.approx: +25 % plumage stack speed modelled as filling the next missing Five-Colour Plumage colour every fourth art fired while own.ward_share > 0

A Crane for the Rider.rule: Crane Bond Rite (passive art, layer 2): each hit your crane companion lands gives you 1 Wind buff stack for 4 s, at most 2 a pulse. When you fire Crane Descends with no bonded crane companion, it calls a crane spirit that fights with you as a companion for 8 s (coefficient 0.5, Wind strikes), once every 20 s.
A Crane for the Rider.approx: Engine summon actions do not carry tags and there is no live own.companions readable; crane_bonded latches on the first crane-tagged companion hit or evade, and while crane_bonded == 0 a 20 s cooldown summon from Crane Descends grants Wind stacks via crane_spirit (each_for 8).

A Fair Copy.rule: Copyist's Pair, full set (2 pieces): once a fight, the first soul art that would land on you does nothing to you and strikes its caster as Cold damage equal to its own (the soul reflect, W2: the engine's reading of "copied, and your next seal art carries it back"). The curse half (the first curse cast on you copied back) is not run: the curse-reflect word was not built (checkpoint 2026-11-27: one half of one Effect, no other owner asks for it).
A Fair Copy.approx: the soul art is reflected at once, not carried back by your next seal art; the curse half is not run (curse-reflect: decision not_run, checkpoint 2026-11-27)

A Hair Light.rule: The House Weight (ck-house-weight): once a fight, you may make one roll that weighs against you come out slightly in your favour (a dodge, a resist or a crit).
A Hair Light.approx: when struck (a defensive roll went against you) while a charge holds, spends 1 charge to tip the next exchange in your favour (+25 evade and +25 status_resist for 3 s, and your next direct hit is a guaranteed crit)

A Room Full of Fume.rule: The Sealed Room, full set (3 pieces): each second, the foe gains 1 Mercury stack (8 s); the Nine-Cycle Gourd's lingering poison no longer stays on you but goes to the foe when you drink.

A Second Early.rule: Snow Hearth, full set (2 pieces): each time a steam art spends Burn stacks (your Burn stacks spent by Steam from the Jacket), you heal 2 % of your health for each stack spent. Pill timing awaits the Alchemy pass.
A Second Early.approx: Pills acting a second sooner is unmodelled until pills have fight timers (Alchemy pass); 'your own Burn stacks' reads your Burn stacks consumed by a steam art (steam-from-the-jacket).

A Second Lean.rule: Thumb on the Scale, full set (2 pieces: ck-house-weight, ck-counterweight-coin): the House Weight's tipped roll comes twice a fight; after each tipped roll you see the next art that foe will use.
A Second Lean.approx: grants +1 House Weight charge at fight_start; after each tipped roll, seeing the foe's next art grants +15 evade and +20 accuracy for 3 s

A Seed for the Fallen.rule: Once a fight, when you would fall, a seed takes root: you stay at 1 health for 2 s and are healed for a fifth of your health when it flowers.

Abbey's Still Water.rule: Lamp of Still Water: the first Water art you cast in each 10 s costs no linh lực.
Abbey's Still Water.approx: Renamed from depth prose Still Water to avoid clash with Đạo Đồ's combat_effects key of the same name.

After the First Blow.rule: Hearing the Spring Rain, full set: the first hit the foe aims at you is heard. If you evade it, your next sword art at the foe is a sure crit.
After the First Blow.approx: Exact engine form: tracks first_blow_seen; evading the first attack sets after_blow_crit = 1, spent as a 1 ms temp_mod sure_crit: 1 (scoped to kind: art, tags: [sword]) on the next damaging sword art_fired.

Ageless Pine.rule: Your Wood buff stacks never fall off during a fight. Closes: Fire resistance -25.

Alchemist's Heart.rule: The first pill you take in each fight counts twice. Closes: pill toxicity fades half as fast.
Alchemist's Heart.not_run: pills are not taken inside fights yet (Alchemy: pill use in combat has no host)

All Birds Bow.rule: The Bird Mother, full set (2 pieces): each time your bird companions strike a foe, your next fan art throws one more feather (a free Fire hit of 0.375 and 1 Fire stack per feather). When three bird companion strikes land in 2 s, the foe gains 2 Slowed Time stacks.
All Birds Bow.approx: companion hit events carry companion tags (bird), not individual beast ids, so bird_strike_2s (each_for 2) counts 3 bird companion hits within 2 s

Anchored Span.rule: The Cloud Bridge Works, full set (3 pieces): while you hold 2 or more Flag charges, each pulse in which the foe acted (foe_pressed) it takes 2 Earth stacks (8 s) and 1 Slowed Time stack (3 s), at most once every 2 s; while you are Composed, your formation arts cost no linh lực (cost_red 0.95 cap) and you recover 1 % linh lực each second.

Answering Wave.rule: Pine Wave True Canon layer 4 passive art: each heal from your arts lays one Wood stack on the foe per 1 % of your health restored and gives you one Water stack.
Answering Wave.approx: Fires on any heal_restored (at most once a pulse) because art heals (a.heal) emit before s.cur_ev is populated; Wood stacks scale uncapped by floor(event.share / 0.01) while Water buff is always 1 stack per heal.

Answers Twice.rule: Heap of Snow, full set (3 pieces): while you hold the sitting stance, your stance ward grows by 2 % of your maximum health each second; when a foe breaks a ward shield or your stance ward, your next counter or seal art fires twice.
Answers Twice.approx: Uses ward_grow {of: 'hp', share: 0.02} (2 % max HP/s, creating a stance ward when none is active) instead of '2 % of its value' because Bồ Tọa Tuyết has no stance-ward art, and filters tags ['counter', 'seal'] because no library art carries 'counter' while Bồ's counter art backwash-seal carries 'seal' (note: a 0 c seal art consumes the proc without echoing a hit).

Armoury Count.rule: Your hits deal 4 % more for each equipped weapon-base artifact you carry. Closes: your wards are 15 % weaker.

Autumn Harvest.rule: Your crits refund the art's cost (3 firings a pulse). Closes: your linh lực regeneration is 0.

Backflow.rule: When you restore health with an art, you regain linh luc equal to 20 % of the health restored, at most 3 % of your maximum linh luc a pulse.
Backflow.approx: the 3 % a pulse cap is written as once a pulse; any heal counts, not only art heals

Banked Coals.rule: Cinder Censer of Lăng Tiêu: once per fight, when you cast a Fire art, the coal flares: the art's burn stacks are doubled, and you take a light burn yourself.

Banked Till Dusk.rule: Evening Glow (2 pieces): before the fight's 20th second your healing-over-time stacks (Wood buffs) last 50 % longer; after it, each one that ends also removes one poison stack (Wood debuff) from you.
Banked Till Dusk.approx: Both engines emit batch_ended only on debuff expiries, not buff expiries; after 20 s while holding Wood buff stacks, cleanses 1 Wood poison stack every 2 s instead of listening for buff batch_ended.

Bare Rack.rule: Your companion hits deal L5 +5 for each empty art slot, cap +20 (the basic-attack half is Pending). Closes (tree keystone): maximum health -15 %.
Bare Rack.engine_choice: companion hits skip the damage layers, so L5 +5 a slot is run as 5 % more damage a slot
Bare Rack.pending: the [basic] half, until Combat adopts the basic tag (#43; re-review EF 24)

Beat to Quarters.rule: War Drum of the Seventh Star: when you fire a summon or formation art (one tagged summon or formation), the drum musters your side: one free Physical hit of 0.5 at once (the engine's reading of "every companion and summon you command strikes once"). Once each 10 s.
Beat to Quarters.approx: the muster is one free hit of 0.5; the engine has no readable for how many companions and summons are out

Before Heaven.rule: Your damage and resistance grow with the number of elements your root owns: L5 +4 and resistance +40 per owned element, cap 5 elements.

Before the Sun.rule: Dawn Pair, full set (2 pieces): your first sword art each fight is a certain crit; if its hit does not make the foe Broken, your ward holds twice as much for 5 s (the engine's reading of "your next ward is doubled": every fighter has a ward). Her master's lesson, half learned.

Beneath Notice.rule: Against an enemy of a higher realm, your escape is likelier.
Beneath Notice.not_run: escape is not in the engine (deferred)

Birds Pay Court to the Phoenix.rule: Five-Virtue Phoenix Canon (passive art, layer 5, authored d36): Each hit your bird companions land lays on you the next Five-Colour Plumage colour you lack, at most once a pulse. Each time you spend a full plumage (five colours), you heal 3 % of your maximum health and your companions' next hits deal 30 % more.
Birds Pay Court to the Phoenix.approx: bird_empowered (cap 1) buffs the next companion hit because engine does not distinguish individual companion instances

Bitter Medicine.rule: Hundred Herbs Tasting (passive art, unlock layer 3, authored wish d33): while you carry fewer than 10 Poison (Wood debuff) stacks, each Poison tick on you deals nothing and heals you for half the damage it would have dealt; at 10 stacks or more, Poison ticks on you deal damage as usual.

Blood Casting.rule: When your linh luc cannot pay for an art, you pay the shortfall in health, 1 for 1. Closes: healing taken -50 % for the fight.

Blood Drinker.rule: When your hit removes enemy health, you restore 6 % of what it dealt. Direct hits only, never ticks or trigger hits.

Bought Fate.rule: Once a fight, a roll that goes against you (a crit you take, an evade that fails, an escape that fails) goes your way instead. Closes: each flip burns 5 % of carried spirit stones.
Bought Fate.approx: the first crit taken is half undone by healing back 40 % of it (a crit's extra share at the default 1.5x is a third); stones are not in the sim

Boundless Sea.rule: Your linh lực pool doubles but no longer regenerates on its own. Closes: linh lực on hit gives nothing.

Branded to the Vein.rule: Keeper of Kinh Lôi Mạch, full set: a foe carrying two or more of your curses is branded. Each of your Lightning bolts that lands on a branded foe adds 1 s to every curse it carries (the curse duration clamp still holds).
Branded to the Vein.approx: Because engine.py has no action to extend already-running status durations, landing a Lightning hit on a foe with 2+ curses grants +25 % curse status_dur for 4 s so subsequent curses run longer up to the clamp.

Breath Held.rule: Three Hundred Paces, full set (2 pieces): while you carry a poison (Wood debuff) or miasma (Corpse Rot) stack, your sword arts are 15 % faster, and each sword hit sheds 1 poison stack (or Corpse Rot) from you.

Brimming Cup.rule: Linh luc lost to a full pool fills your Cup: you gain 1 Water buff stack for 8 s for every 5 % of maximum linh luc lost, at most 2 stacks a pulse.
Brimming Cup.approx: each pulse's overflow counts on its own (a part under 5 % is lost, not carried)

Brittle from Its Own Blow.rule: Star-Quench Canon (passive art, layer 4, authored wish d30): each hit from a foe you block gives the foe 1 Quench mark (Metal debuff stack, 8 s), at most once a second. When your hit lays a Quench mark on a foe carrying your Burn, it spends all Burn stacks on it and lays 1 more Quench mark for every 3 spent (rounded down).

Brush Away the Dust.rule: Once every 20 s, the whisk brushes one debuff off you and turns its remaining time into a ward of the same length.
Brush Away the Dust.approx: Cleanses 1 curse status or 1 element debuff stack every 20 s when one is held, granting a fixed 8 % health ward (remaining batch time is not a readable).

Burn and Get Back Up.rule: Standing in the Fire, full set (3 pieces: pvd-xich-ha-ky, pvd-moving-fire-hide, pvd-cradle-feather): each time your body shield breaks (drops from positive to 0 on a hit taken), you regain 15 % of your maximum health and arm your next fist strike (fist art or basic blow) to deal an extra Fire free hit of 2.0. Once a fight (wearing the Xích Hà Kỳ as part of the set, superseding its 20 % rise), a blow that would put you Down leaves you standing at 33 % of your maximum health.

Burning Feathers.rule: The Hall Stands, full set (2 pieces): each fan crit lays one more Burn batch. Against a foe who carries ten or more of your Burn batches, your Fire crit chance rises by 10 %.

Burning Ground.rule: Your Earth arts leave burning ground: the foe gains 2 Burn stacks, once per art firing.

Burning Lifespan.rule: Once a fight, when your health first falls to 30 % or below, you burn years for 5 s of fury: L5 +40 on all hits and art speed +30 for 5 s. Closes: the result reports 2 % of your realm's base lifespan in years lost, win or lose.
Burning Lifespan.pending: the lifespan the fight burns: the fight result does not report years yet (Realms / Time & Turn host)

Call of the Luan.rule: Blue Luan Whistle: once per fight when your health falls to 80 % or below, your bonded birds answer the whistle: you regain 8 % of your maximum health (companions have no HP in Combat rule 19, so the shared roosting meridian heals the holder) and your next Loose the Flock sends one more bird.
Call of the Luan.approx: bonded birds have no health bar (Combat rule 19), so 'returns to full health' heals the holder 8 % max HP; triggers once per fight at own.hp_share <= 0.8

Called Blow.rule: Your crit chance is counted on a visible meter, not rolled (Effects Formulas A). Closes: crit chance cap 0.50 -> 0.35.

Chars in a Season.rule: Robe of the First Weave (chc-first-weave-robe): the robe must be rewoven each season; unrewoven, its modifiers fall by a quarter each season until it is ash.
Chars in a Season.not_run: out-of-fight seasonal craft/upkeep rule: reweaving and seasonal decay occur between seasons, not inside a duel

Clear Note.rule: Clear Bell: your ward rings when it is struck; each time it absorbs damage, the foe's next art is delayed by 0.5 s (at most once every 3 seconds).

Clear-Heart Reflection.rule: Clear-Heart Mirror: once a fight, the first soul or heart-demon art that would land on you does nothing to you and strikes its caster as Cold damage equal to its own.

Cold Feet.rule: Your escape art's first firing comes at cooldown_min.
Cold Feet.not_run: escape is not in the engine (deferred)

Colour of the Hour.rule: Robe of the Drifting Glow: from the 20th second of a fight, your health regeneration and healing are 15 % stronger, and stronger again by 15 % (+30 % total) from the 40th second.
Colour of the Hour.approx: healing scales regeneration (which passes through heal()), pulsed heals, and direct heals alike at +15 % from 20 s and +30 % from 40 s; the engine has no HoT-only healing mod

Contract Paid in Full.rule: Contract Seal of the Valley (py-contract-seal): while protecting a hirer, take 20 % less damage and heal when you strike (carried by the Seal's 15 % leech).
Contract Paid in Full.approx: Renamed from Paid in Full to avoid colliding with market-folk's Golden Valley Ledger Seal (Paid in Full), and separated from Hired Sword's Pair (2pc) so the Seal alone does not grant the 2pc crit heal. Single-side 1v1 duel adaptation (no allied hirer NPC exists in 1v1 combat): on was_hit (cooldown 4 s): +20 dampen_taken for 2 s; py-contract-seal's own leech_health_pct 15 provides heal on strike.

Cool the Burn.rule: Fan of Rain on the Pines: your heals also remove one Fire stack from you.

Crack the Ice.rule: Flags That Broke the Ice: while you hold the Flag charges, a foe that has been Composed for 3 s cannot evade for 2 s and takes an Ice stack (Water's debuff, Effects rule 9a) each second.
Crack the Ice.approx: Flag charges are treated as standing while the Flags are worn (no authored Flag art); lays Ice debuff stacks (Water's debuff under Effects GDD rule 9a, scaling with Water purity via water_ice_share) and refreshes a 6 s ice_chill array marker for Ground Set Before.

Cut to the Root.rule: Shang Mountain Lingzhi Canon (layer 12 passive): once a fight, a killing blow cuts you only to the root: you grow back with 15 % of your maximum health.

Dark of the Moon.rule: After you evade, your next hit crits (once per pulse).

Dawn Ink.rule: Southern Shore Cloud Seal: Wood debuff batches your talismans lay in the first 10 s of a fight last 50 % longer, and each Wood debuff batch that expires unspent returns 2 % of your maximum linh lực.
Dawn Ink.approx: "talismans you lay" is read on the Wood debuff batches laid by your talisman arts: batches laid in the first 10 s gain stack_dur 50, and each Wood batch ending naturally (batch_ended) returns 2 % of maximum linh lực.

Daybreak.rule: Your first Light hit each fight lays the foe bare (Exposed, 3 pulses).
Daybreak.engine_choice: a Light hit is a hit of an art tagged light (no art in the library carries it yet)

Debt of Stone.rule: When an art of yours is paid in health, you gain 1 Earth buff stack for 15 s for each 2 % of maximum health paid.

Deep Freeze.rule: Each time your Ice stacks on a target cross a multiple of 10, that target's art with the least time left is delayed by 1 s, once every 2 pulses. Closes: your arts cost 10 % more linh luc.
Deep Freeze.approx: fires on any Ice grant at 10 or more stacks, once every 2 pulses, rather than exactly at each multiple of 10

Do Not Listen.rule: Heart That Does Not Listen to the Rain (passive art, layer 1): A passive ward: incoming soul damage is reduced by 15 % and charm resistance is raised by 20 %; each soul hit, song hit or pulse under Charm raises the ward by 1 stack (+5 % soul resistance and +5 % charm resistance each), and the raise fades by a tenth each second.
Do Not Listen.approx: Uses decay_share: 0.1 on unheeding_ward (fades 10 % every pulse, including the pulse it was raised). Raises on soul_taken, was_hit (tags: [song]), and pulse while own.status.charmed >= 1 (engine has no status_taken event on the target).

Drag It to the Ice.rule: Old Ivory Hunt, full set (3 pieces): while the foe is Bound (it cannot flee), each second Bound holds you heal 1 % of your health and the foe takes 4 % more Physical damage from you; the bonus lasts while Bound holds and ends when Bound ends.

Drawn from the River.rule: River Tongs (tht-river-tongs): once a fight, when you fall below a third of your health, you lose all Burn stacks and gain +60 % ward strength for 5 s (approximating block rating times ten ward points).
Drawn from the River.approx: "ward equal to your block rating times ten for a few seconds" is modelled as ward_pct +60 for 5 s (~300 ward points on a typical Trúc Cơ holder, matching ~30 block rating times 10).

Drumbeat.rule: Every fourth art you fire in a fight is a guaranteed crit, and each such crit gives you 1 Thunder buff stack. Closes: your other arts have 8 less crit chance.
Drumbeat.approx: the Thunder stack lasts 8 s (the rule gives no length)

Earth Vein Tap.rule: While your own formation stands, linh lực regeneration +50 % increased; with none, none. Closes: no linh lực regeneration while no formation of yours stands.
Earth Vein Tap.not_run: formations do not stand inside fights yet (Formations host)

Earthen Armour.rule: After 3 s without being hit, your body shield refills 10 % a pulse. Closes: maximum linh lực -20 %.
Earthen Armour.engine_choice: 10 % of the starting bar a pulse, up to the starting bar

Ebb Tide.rule: The first time in a fight your linh lực falls below 30 %, restore 30 % of it. Closes: maximum linh lực -15 %.
Ebb Tide.engine_choice: checked after each art you fire and each hit you take

Echo.rule: When one of your arts lands a hit, it has a 25 % chance to strike again for free: c_trig 0.5, same tags, once per firing, inside the trigger budget.
Echo.approx: once per firing is written as once a pulse

Edge Returns the Breath.rule: Each crit with a Physical hit restores 0.8 % of your maximum linh luc. Closes: your non-Physical hits cannot crit.

Eight Marks.rule: The Envoy's Errand, full set (3 pieces): when the fan's art (Fan Gust) strikes a foe carrying 4 or more Earth stacks, its guard breaks for 4 s (Exposed -100 resistance and your hits bypass 30 % of its ward), and each guard broken this way loads a mark; your next song art heals you 2 % of your maximum health per mark and spends them.
Eight Marks.approx: 'block and ward 30 % weaker' is Exposed (4 s) plus bypass 0.30 (4 s)

Eight of Nine.rule: Tiêu Thiều Quản (pm-tieu-thieu-quan): Played as an art, each movement lays one Shao stack on the foe; a foe with eight stacks holds its arts: those that come ready in the next 2 s wait until the 2 s end. The ninth movement is not an art: while it plays, no hearer of lower realm can act against the player. Story use only.
Eight of Nine.approx: each song art fired lays 1 Shao stack on the foe, and when foe Shao reaches 8 it stops the foe's clock for 2 s (cooldown 6 s); the ninth movement's lower-realm pacification is story-only

Embers Feed the Hearth.rule: Each Burn tick you deal returns linh luc equal to 0.4 % of your maximum, at most 2 ticks a pulse.

Embers Never Die.rule: Your Burn on a target cannot be cleansed. A cleanse that would remove it removes the same number of your own Fire buff stacks instead. Closes: your own wards cannot cleanse you.
Embers Never Die.approx: the closing is not run (no ward in the sim cleanses its wearer)

Envoys Are Not Struck.rule: Envoy's Jade Tally: until you strike (your art or basic attack lands a hit), the first hit on you each fight is halved (you heal half of what it did at once), and while you have struck no one your escape rolls cannot fail (escape +100: you may leave at once, if you hold an escape art).

Eruption.rule: Your costly Fire arts (cost share 10 % or more, the costly tag) deal L5 +15.

Ever-Burning Furnace.rule: Every Burn stack your hits apply returns +0.2 pp of maximum linh lực (10 stacks a pulse). Closes: your linh lực regeneration is 0.

Every Day of the Year.rule: Fan of the Following Wind: while you carry a Water buff stack, slows and timer delays do not slow you, and your first evade each fight grants 2 Water buff stacks (8 s).
Every Day of the Year.approx: status_immune (slowed_time) and delay_immune apply against all foe slows and delays while carrying a Water buff stack, because the engine's status_immune and delay_immune checks do not expose the foe art's element.

Every Debt Called.rule: Debt and Wall, full set (3 pieces): the Vô Định Tally also adds 1 mark each time you block damage (once per hit, never double-counted with damage taken), may be called a second time each fight (at 8 more marks or <= 40 % HP), and each call grants a body shield of 2 % of your maximum health per tallied mark.
Every Debt Called.approx: shield size is 2 % max HP per tallied mark (matching the Tally's per-mark return approximation)

Every Debt Written.rule: Vô Định Tally: each damaging blow you take adds 1 mark to your tally. Once per fight, when the tally reaches 8 marks or you fall to half health (with at least 1 mark), you call the tally: the foe takes a Physical Earth-ledger strike of c 0.35 per tallied mark (outside the trigger budget), and the tally resets.
Every Debt Written.approx: return_damage cannot read an accumulated damage counter, so a third of damage dealt is approximated as c 0.35 per tallied blow (outside_budget) auto-called at 8 marks or <= 50 % HP

Every Fifth a Star.rule: Clear Glaze, full set: each time a foe reaches 5 of your Ice stacks, your next sword cut against it is a sure crit and half of its damage goes past the foe's ward.
Every Fifth a Star.approx: "ignores the foe's ward" is bypass 0.5, the engine's bypass_cap; a full ward pass exists only on free hits (pass_shields)

Every Lamp Has a Name.rule: Lamp of the Soul Vaults: A foe you have cursed cannot hide: concealment and evasion do not work against your arts while your curse is on them, and each time it ticks they lose a little linh lực to you.
Every Lamp Has a Name.approx: Grants 1 ms acc: 500 on art_fired while foe.curses >= 1 (evasion fails without stealing a curse slot or failing to status_resist); drains 1.5 % foe max linh lực to self on tick_dealt while foe.curses >= 1, plus once per 2 s on pulse while foe.curses >= 1 for non-tick curses.

Everything at Once.rule: Far Ambition (2 pieces): when you use a pill, your next needle art casts at once and puts double Wood stacks, and your heals are 20 % stronger for 3 s.
Everything at Once.approx: Cuts cooldown on the longest-cooling art by 10 s (not filtered to needle arts, as tv-polygala-needle uses base common art under R6) and grants +2 flat Wood debuff stacks for 3 s (stack_grant is additive, not multiplicative).

False Moon.rule: Moon-Fish Lantern: while the lantern is lit, your Moon in the Water reflection lasts twice as long (adds +4 s to its 4 s window), and while it is up you regenerate linh lực as if cultivating (+0.035 regen bonus, doubling base meditation regeneration).

Fan the Pyre.rule: Each Fire hit you land refreshes the duration of every Burn batch you have on the target. Closes: your direct Fire hits deal 8 % less (softened from 15 %, user decision 2026-11-13).

Ferry Across.rule: The Ferryman's Remedy (2 pieces): when you heal below half health, you shed one Wood debuff stack and gain one Wood buff stack; once every 6 s.
Ferry Across.approx: Engine Poison is element wood debuff; cleanses 1 Wood stack + adds 1 Wood buff.

Field and Garden.rule: Field and Garden (3 pieces): your heals over time also grant one Earth guard stack each second they tick, and while you hold 5 or more Earth guard stacks your health regeneration is doubled.

Fights With What He Made.rule: The Xích Kim Furnace, full set: when you block a hit, your Sword's next strike comes hot from the furnace: it deals 30 % more damage, ignores 95 resistance points (~20 % of a typical ward) and adds 2 Metal stacks (8 s).
Fights With What He Made.approx: ignores 20 % of the target's defence is modelled as pen 95 (resistance penetration in points, ~20 % of a Kết Đan foe's typical ~479 ward points), since engine `pierce` only pierces realm suppression.

Figure on the Clouds.rule: Mother's Sky (Mẫu Thiên Song Bảo), full set (2 pieces): your reflection-double lasts 3 s longer; while it stands, your Water arts cost 10 % less; when it falls (by timeout or ward break), you gain 2 Water buff stacks for 10 s.

Final Clause.rule: Once a fight, as you go Down, your longest-cooldown art fires at no cost (ties to the earlier slot).

Fire Down the Thread.rule: The Nest Array, full set (3 pieces): while an array you laid (a Field) is up, each Fire buff stack you gain also lays a ward thread on you worth 2 % of your health, and each new thread costs 1 % of your linh lực. A hit that breaks a thread deals its value back to the striker as Fire damage.
Fire Down the Thread.approx: scales by event.stacks on Fire buff gain when own.field_up >= 1 and own.qi_share >= 0.05 (to guard against negative linh lực on multi-stack gains); shield break returns a 0.6 Fire free hit

Fire Feeds Fire.rule: Your Burn stacks on the foe never fall off while you hit it at least once every 3 s. Closes: Water arts you slot deal 50 % less.
Fire Feeds Fire.engine_choice: each hit you land keeps every Burn batch of yours on the foe until at least 3 s later

Fire Lotus.rule: Your crits apply two more Burn stacks. Closes: crit damage -30 %.
Fire Lotus.engine_choice: the two stacks last 6 s, a typical Fire art's Burn batch

Fire Runs the Thread.rule: The Unbroken Thread (chc-unbroken-thread, 2 pieces): while a foe is bound by your thread, each Wood stack on them also burns as a Fire hit (c 0.03 per Wood stack each second). When the binding ends, the fire leaps back along the thread and lays one Fire stack (6 s) for every three Wood stacks it held.

First Stand.rule: At the start of a fight, your body shield is already raised to 30 % of your maximum health. It does not refill.

First Thunder.rule: Your first art each fight fires at cooldown_min.

Fished from the Shallows.rule: Nails of Đào Sa, full set (2 pieces): each needle hit (Needle Rain or any needle-tagged art) on a foe with 3 or more Earth stacks lays 1 more Earth stack (8 s); when a foe hits you, your next needle volley is a certain crit across every needle in the volley (once every 6 s).

Flowing Water.rule: When you crit, your other arts' timers shorten by 0.5 s (3 firings a pulse). Closes (tree keystone): your art costs +40 %.

Forced to Seed.rule: The Yearly Seed, full set (3 pieces): each Fire art you cast resets the dry clock, refreshes every Wood buff stack on you, and adds 1 Wood buff stack for 10 s. If you go 10 s without casting a Fire art while carrying Wood buff stacks, all your Wood buff stacks flower at once: each heals 3 % of maximum health, they are consumed, and the 10 s clock restarts.

Formed in a Storm.rule: Thunder on the Cone, full set: each Fire hit you land counts as half a Lightning hit for your Thunder arts' stacks and chains.
Formed in a Storm.approx: Counts Fire art hits (element: fire, kind: art — matches both physical and elemental Fire arts) in fire_storm_halves; every 2nd Fire hit adds 1 Thunder debuff stack (8 s) and fires a small Lightning chain bolt (c 0.45, dtype: lightning).

Forty Answer.rule: Bridge Bells, full set (2 pieces): bells hung with Hang the Bells answer your hand bell: each second the foe acts (foe_pressed), every Bell charge you hold rings once for 0.25 Physical, at most once per second.

Frost Seal.rule: Your Ice stacks on the foe stop falling off once it holds 10 or more. Closes: Fire arts you slot deal 50 % less.

Frost on the Field.rule: Thanh Sương, Blue Frost: without Ice, the sword's cold modifiers sleep. Against a slowed foe (Slowed Time), each Ice debuff grant you lay adds 1 extra Ice stack (doubling single-stack grants), and when woken by its scabbard (Waits for Its Blade), sword hits on a slowed foe lay 1 Ice stack (8 s, doubled to 2).

Geese Line.rule: Standard of the First File (d17): while the standard stands (+8) and while Geese Stance holds (+8), you gain +8 block rating for each anchor of the file.

Geese in the Cold.rule: What Came Off the Field, full set (3 pieces): while your Field stands (field_up, standing ruling R1), damage you take is dampened by 10 %; the first time you are Wounded while your Field stands, your sword hits gain two extra blades for the rest of the fight (a bonus c 0.32 Physical hit on each sword hit).
Geese in the Cold.approx: long-sky-one-colour is parked, so 'One Colour field' reads own.field_up (satisfied by Sunset Cloud); two blades equal 2 x 8 % of a flying sword strike (2 x 0.08 x 1.97 = c 0.32)

Glass Meridians.rule: Your arts run far faster (art speed +40), on a fragile body. Closes: maximum health -25 %; your body shields hold half.

Glass Rings.rule: Coloured-Glass Flying Sword: When this sword is used as a lightning rod, the bolt it draws strikes twice, and you take a twentieth of your health as Lightning damage each time.
Glass Rings.approx: When sword-raised-to-the-cloud lands, fires a duplicate Lightning bolt (c 2.2, dtype lightning) and takes a Lightning self_hit (c 9.5, calibrated to ~5 % of holder max HP against an equal-realm foe after Lightning resistance; engine has no flat % max-HP self-damage action on Effects).

Glow After Dark.rule: Prize and Brush, full set (2 pieces): each talisman or seal art you fire loads a glow charge (10 s). When one of your debuff batches expires unspent on the foe while a glow charge holds, it spends 1 charge and fires a half-strength strike (c 1.2 Physical) at the foe.
Glow After Dark.approx: unspent expiry is read via batch_ended on your debuffs after firing a talisman or seal art; half strength is a fixed c 1.2 Physical free hit

Going Once, Going Twice.rule: Hammer, Pearl and Coin, full set: when Hammer Price spends 10 or more Metal stacks, you keep a third of them on the foe; Bought Fate pays 4 % of max health from the Seal's stance ward while it holds and may flip a second crit taken per fight by spending another 4 %; and while you still hold that stance ward at Down, a killing blow spends the stance ward instead of cracking the Pearl.
Going Once, Going Twice.approx: Effects rule 11 caps Down refusals at 1 per fight (`refusals: 1`), so while the Seal's stance ward holds at Down (for example against ticks, Soul hits or shield-bypassing strikes), the Pearl's save spends that ward instead of cracking rather than granting a second Down refusal in the same fight; spirit stones are not in the sim.

Gone Before Thanks.rule: The Grey Sleeve (py-grey-sleeve): when a foe you struck falls Broken (or dies/flees), you vanish for 2 s: you gain 1 decoy and +40 evade for 2 s, and your next Metal strike is a certain critical hit.
Gone Before Thanks.approx: In 1v1 combat, foe death/flight ends the fight, so Gone Before Thanks triggers on Broken (foe falling to 25 % health); 'cannot be targeted' runs as 1 decoy + 40 evade for 2 s.

Grave-Silk Shroud.rule: Corpse Rot is on the enemy from t = 0 without taking a slot. Closes: 15 % of maximum linh luc reserved for the fight.

Green Fire.rule: Burns from your Wood arts deal 25 % more to the foe below half health. Out of a fight, pills brewed in the furnace come out one grade cleaner, as if your Đan Đạo were one level higher (craft rule; no modifier key exists for it).
Green Fire.approx: Below 50 % foe health, boosts over_time direct hits by 25 % (`dmg_more`) and echoes 25 % of each post-defence Wood tick directly via `tick_dealt` `return_damage` (`dtype: "soul"` bypasses a second resistance pass and non-tick flat block, matching exact +25 % Wood burn damage in both Python and GDScript); out-of-fight Đan Đạo +1 craft rule is not modeled in combat.

Grinding Weight.rule: Your slow arts apply a stack of Slowed Time, once per art firing.

Gripping Root.rule: When your Physical Wood hit lands, the target's art with the least time left is delayed by 0.5 s, once per 2 s.

Ground Set Before.rule: The Ice-Breaker's Array, full set: arrays and curses you lay in the first 5 s of a fight last 50 % longer, and while your array (a Field) is up, a foe that stays cursed for 3 s cannot evade for 1.5 s and takes an Ice stack (Water's debuff, Effects rule 9a); once every 10 s.
Ground Set Before.approx: Uses time <= 5 for opening +50 % curse duration (arrays have no duration mod); accepts either own.field_up >= 1 or Crack the Ice's 6 s ice_chill marker as the set's array being up; lays an Ice debuff stack (Water's debuff under Effects GDD rule 9a).

Grown, Not Made.rule: The Grown Red Pearl: cannot be stolen, sold or broken out of combat. Once a fight, a blow that would put you Down is taken by the pearl instead (leaving you at 15 % health); it cracks for the rest of the fight and loses its combat modifiers (ward_pct -10, L1 -10, Metal buff stack_dur -24). Skipped while Going Once, Going Twice spends the Seal's stance ward instead.
Grown, Not Made.approx: cannot-be-stolen/sold/broken is out-of-fight; losing the pearl's static modifiers (khi_huyet_pct 15, than_thuc_pct 8, stack_effect_pct 24 [kim, buff]) mid-fight is approximated by ward_pct -10, L1 -10 and Metal buff stack_dur -24.

Half Lake.rule: The Hundred Jars, full set: a foe carrying six or more of your Water stacks gains one Drunk stack each pulse while it stays at six or more.

Half of a Pair.rule: Phi Hồng, Flying Red: while Tàn Hồng is not held by the same person, this sword's crit chance (+8 % [sword]) counts only against a foe carrying your Wood stacks. Held together with Tàn Hồng, each crit with either sword scatters a petal that gives the foe one Wood stack (Tàn Hồng is lost in slot V-1).
Half of a Pair.approx: Tàn Hồng is not in the game yet, so only the un-paired half runs: -8 crit [sword] while the foe carries 0 Wood stacks.

Haze Held All Night.rule: The Dusk Field (3 pieces): healing you would receive from your own arts while the Cold Furnace is unlit is stored in it instead, and the store fades by a twentieth each second; when the furnace lights, the store is restored to you at once, and lighting it costs you no health.
Haze Held All Night.approx: While furnace_lit == 0, heal_taken -50 holds back half of all incoming heals and heal_restored / heal_overflow store event.share (fading 5 % per second via decay_share 0.05) — unfiltered because art.heal and pulse-released heals do not carry kind: art; when furnace_lit >= 1, the full store is restored with ignore_taken and Unlit's 10 % HP cost is waived via dusk_no_lit_cost.

Hear It Coming.rule: Robe of the Listening Dawn: the first art each fight that would stun or root you is heard before it lands, and fails.
Hear It Coming.approx: Grants status_immune to sleep, charmed, bound, off_guard and delay_immune for the opening 15 s (time <= 15) because the engine does not emit a blocked-status event to spend a one-shot ward.

Heard Before It Falls.rule: Ears of the Hall, full set: you always evade the first art a foe casts at you each fight, and the bell rings a ward on you worth 8 % of your health. A foe you have heard is marked, and your seals on a marked foe last 2 s longer.
Heard Before It Falls.approx: Grants opening decoy (1) + 8 % ward at fight_start (note: engine decoy avoids any first direct hit including an opening basic attack, as decoy has no kind filter); on decoy_struck raises evaded and marks foe via heard_marked = 1, granting +67 % status_dur on curses (tags: [curse], +2 s on 3 s base seals/curses up to the 5 s curse clamp).

Heard Once.rule: Zither of Clear Sound: out of combat, arts taught to the holder by voice are learned 20 % faster.
Heard Once.not_run: Out-of-combat manual/voice art learning is outside fight simulations.

Heard Through the Roots.rule: Canon of the Bells in the Canopy (passive art, layer 4): the first strike each fight against you while you hold a Bell charge is warned (+30 pp evade) and partly evaded (if it still lands, it deals half damage).

Heat the Edge.rule: Fallen Star Forge, full set (3 pieces, authored wish d43): each Fire art you fire heats your sword one step (Heat), each step giving +4 % pierce. Once it holds 5 steps or more, your next sword art quenches it: a certain crit that wakes Sky Iron Sings (3 rings) and clears all Heat steps.
Heat the Edge.approx: pierce +4 % per Heat step applies to all hits while Heat holds rather than [kim, sword] alone because engine.py reads pierce without hit context; Heat only builds on Fire arts and clears on the first sword crit at 5+ steps.

Heaven's Eye.rule: Your crits against an Exposed foe deal L5 +20 on that hit. Closes: your ward strength is 30 % lower.

Heaven's Verdict.rule: Your slow Thunder arts deal L5 +20 against a foe below half health.

Hidden Half.rule: Black and White Stones, full set (2 pieces): each time a foe gains its fourth Ice stack from you, it is also cursed with Heavy Breath for 3 s; while it carries a curse, each grant of Ice you lay on it gives 1 more stack (review R2, refined: stack_grant).

Hidden Moon.rule: Your evade also counts as crit chance, point for point. Closes: your block and body shield count nothing; maximum health -20 %.

Hired Sword's Full Pay.rule: Hired Sword's Pair (py-hired-pair, 2 pieces): while protecting a hirer, each critical hit you land heals 2 % of your health; if the hirer leaves the fight alive, you are healed in full once.
Hired Sword's Full Pay.approx: Renamed from Paid in Full to avoid colliding with market-folk's Paid in Full and separated from py-contract-seal's 1-piece Effect. Single-side 1v1 duel adaptation: on crit (per_pulse 1): heal 2 % max health. Post-fight full heal if hirer survives is unmodelled in 1v1.

Hold the Quay.rule: The Governor's Charge (2 pieces): after 3 s Composed (no damaging/movement act or 3 s in a Composed stance), you take 12 % less damage and your Off-Guard/Bound roots last 1 s longer.
Hold the Quay.approx: Uses own.since_act >= 3 or own.composed_time >= 3 for 3 s without moving, dampen_taken: 12 for 12 % less damage taken, and status_dur: 100 scoped to [off_guard, bound] to extend 1 s roots by 1 s. Note: fight.py and build_file_compiler.gd currently attach set Effects only on full sets (3/3), so 2/3 activation on nhiep_co_tan awaits partial-set Effect support.

Horse and Rider Bear It Together.rule: Bridle Ring of Đạp Vân (authored wish d42): while a companion fights beside you (has struck within the last 6 s), direct hits on you deal 15 % less (dampen_taken 17.65), and each direct hit you take adds one tired share for 5 s (-2 % companion damage each). A joint strike (you and your companion hitting the foe within 1 s) rests it fully, clearing all tired shares.
Horse and Rider Bear It Together.approx: Engine has no own.companions readable or avoid-share verb; companion presence is tracked for 6 s after each companion hit (companion_present), and the 15 % share taken by the horse runs as dampen_taken 17.65 (1 / 1.1765 = 0.85 on direct hits, never ticks or Soul).

Hundred Refinements.rule: Half your artifact power also counts as attack. Closes: art speed -20 %.

Hundred-Feather Fan.rule: Moulted Feather Fan (passive art, layer 2): for each different feather kind in the holder's fan (counted by item grade), her Fire stacks last a little longer.
Hundred-Feather Fan.approx: uses own.tech_layer.moulted-feather-fan (+2 % stack_dur for Fire debuffs per layer) because the combat engine has no item_grade readable

Ice in the Vessel.rule: Jade Vessel of the Ice Heart: while you are Composed, your stance ward regains 2 % of its peak each second (never past it). Out of fights, heart-demon odds at a breakthrough fall by a third while the Vessel is worn (the Vessel's tam_ma_resist_pct 33 line, review R3).

Immovable Mountain.rule: Slowed Time and timer delays never land on you. Closes: art speed modifiers do nothing for you.

Iron Skin Renewed.rule: When you fire an art with a Physical part, your body shield regains 2 % of maximum health, once a pulse.

It Does Not Cool.rule: Nine-Year Ember: your Burn stacks on a foe wait when the foe evades any of your strikes (refreshed to at least 6 s); once a fight, when a cleanse puts out more than 5 of your Burn stacks, the ember restores them (8 s).
It Does Not Cool.approx: Fight pauses already freeze debuff timers via stop_clock; hiding/evasion is modelled on was_evaded refreshing Burn batches to 6 s, and putting out Burn by a Water hit is modelled on cleansed with amount > 5.

It Hums.rule: Drumstick of the Gate: Each Thunder stack you apply also gives you one charge, and each charge fades after 4 s. At four or more, your next Thunder art spends them all, sounds like a drum and stuns the foe for half a second, and a tenth of a second longer for each charge past four.
It Hums.approx: Exact engine form: listens on status_applied (element: thunder, scale event.stacks) to add hum_charge (each_for 4 s); on next Thunder art_fired with hum_charge >= 4, stops foe clock by 0.1 + 0.1 * N s (= 0.5 s at N = 4, +0.1 s per charge past 4) and zeroes hum_charge before hit_landed applies new Thunder stacks.

Keen Edge.rule: Your hits ignore the foe's block. Closes: your own block rating counts nothing.

Keep Singing.rule: The Unwritten Score, full set: while you cast Wood arts with no gap over 1.5 s, each chained art gives one Song stack (+2 % Wood art speed and +3 % soul resistance each, fading 8 s after gained, uncapped). A soul hit or Silence takes 4 Song instead.
Keep Singing.approx: Uses a 1.5 s charge counter (song_gap, refreshed via add: 1) so only consecutive Wood casts within 1.5 s grant Song; on unreflected soul_taken, spends 4 Song to restore health equal to event.amount (linh lực loss not refunded); at 4+ Song, grants Silence immunity without spending Song because the engine emits no blocked-status event.

Keeper of the Hours.rule: Ring of the Armillary: arrays you lay last a third longer, and the first array you lay in a fight is laid at no cost.
Keeper of the Hours.approx: the first formation art is free via next_art_cost 0; +1/3 array duration extends The Stars Bow to 11 s (on open and on The Handle Turns refresh) and adds a 0.10 c / 19 s lingering ring pulse per Ring of the Hour (+33.9 % total output over the 19 s window, since no duration modifier exists on summon or each_for counters)

Kindled Wound.rule: Your Fire parts deal more to a target bearing your Burn: L5 +15, scope fire.

Know the Way Out.rule: Envoy's Jade Tally (authored wish d2): each escape you fail this fight makes your next escape 10 % likelier (escape +10, no cap); a success ends the fight, which clears it.

Ký Tế.rule: Water Over Fire, full set (3 pieces): your Burn stacks on the foe are refreshed to at least 4 s whenever you are healed, and each heal art you cast turns 1 Burn stack on the foe into a steam burst of Fire damage equal to 3 s of that Burn (0.06 c Fire free hit).
Ký Tế.approx: 3 s of 1 Burn stack (0.019 c/s) is expressed as a 0.06 c Fire free hit.

Lamp on the Quay.rule: While the lamp's light (a Field) is up, the foe cannot become hidden, and a hidden foe is revealed when the Field rises.
Lamp on the Quay.approx: No distinct hidden/concealed status exists in engine.py yet; modeled while own.field_up >= 1 as +15 accuracy to pierce evasion and applying Off Guard (2 s) each time a Field rises.

Lamp on the Road.rule: Guide's Lamp: The foe cannot be unseen (+20 accuracy for the fight). Once per fight, your first escape art costs no linh lực and your escape chance is raised by 50.
Lamp on the Road.approx: One-on-one fight.py has no stealth/unseen state: 'cannot be unseen' grants +20 acc for the fight, and 'leave at no cost once per fight' waives the first escape-tagged art's cost via next_art_cost: 0.0 and grants +50 escape chance (a holder without an escape art never auto-flees).

Lamp-Lit Reading.rule: Each different status of yours on the target lowers its soul resistance by 3 points, to at most 5 statuses. Closes: your own soul resistance is 15 points lower.

Lamp-Ward.rule: Lamp-Ward (Thủ Đăng, lamp-ward-seal-canon L3 passive art): each Seal charge you gain turns 1 more blow before it ends, plus 1 more for every 3 Seal charges you already hold when you gain it.

Last Man in the File.rule: Out of the Grey, full set (3 pieces): while the raised standard stands, you gain +20 block rating as though you had raised the shield, and each blocked hit lets you shed 1 Wood poison stack and 1 Corpse Rot miasma stack (once every 3 s).

Layered Against the Tide.rule: The Breakwater, full set (3 pieces: vtd-breakwater-seal, vtd-sea-wall-shield, vtd-jetty-stone): each blow your shield or wards turn adds a layer that fades after 5 s, and each layer cuts the damage you take by a further 4 %. At five or more layers your next seal spends them all and lays 2 Heavy Breath on the foe, and one more for every five layers past five.

Layered Earth.rule: Each hit you block raises your defence by 3 % until the fight ends, cap +30. Closes: your evade counts nothing.
Layered Earth.engine_choice: defence is ward strength, read live (ward_pct)

Lean Until It Breaks.rule: Cliff Hall Champion (3 pieces): each hit on a foe whose guard you cracked adds a Wood stack and 3 % pierce against it, and every tenth such hit breaks the foe's block for 3 s; the pierce falls by 3 % each second you do not hit that foe.

Let You Burn Out.rule: Master of the Sittings, full set (3 pieces: pvd-cinder-knuckle-ring, pvd-sitting-stone-mail, pvd-weiqi-board-shield): each hit you block or take on your body shield adds 1 heat stack (feather_heat) to your store (counted once per hit). At 10 or more heat, your next fist art hit releases all heat as a Fire free hit (0.20 per heat stack, no cap), resets heat to 0, and for 3 s each hit the foe lands on you inflicts a 2-stack Fire Burn batch (6 s, up to 2 a pulse).

Light as a Startled Goose.rule: Swan Goose and Swimming Dragon, full set: each time the Sash slips a blow, you regrow 4 % of your health over 4 s and the attacker cannot evade for 1 s.

Light on the Moss.rule: A quarter of the healing you receive is stored, and released on you the next time you fall below half health.

Light on the Pipe.rule: The Morning the Birds Fell Silent, full set (2 pieces): every fifth soul art you play on the pipe also lays Exposed on the foe.

Light on the Quay.rule: The Governor's Charge, full set (3 pieces): while you hold all three and stay Composed, the lantern lights a Field around you: you heal 1 % of your health each second and the foe is Slowed; a foe that cannot evade for 2 s is struck by a palm counter.
Light on the Quay.approx: Runs the lantern's Field directly on own.composed >= 1 without claiming the single stance slot so Rooted Form stays active.

Lightning Drinker.rule: When a Lightning part hits you, 20 % of the damage it deals after resistance returns as linh luc.

Lightning and Frost.rule: Twin Swords of the Armoury, full set (2 pieces): wakes both swords' sleeping elements at half strength for any holder (+10 % attack, +5 % crit chance, +6 % art speed on non-Lightning sword arts; +10 % attack, +5 % art speed on non-Cold sword arts), wakes Tử Điện's half-strength fork on non-Lightning sword art hits, and each sword hit lays 1 Thunder and 1 Ice debuff stack (6 s; Frost on the Field doubles the Ice stack against a slowed foe).

Lingering Afterimage.rule: Your Blade counters (Afterimages, Coils) do not decay. Closes: your basic attack deals 30 % less.
Lingering Afterimage.approx: counter decay belongs to the build's own counters; a build with Blade counters writes its no-decay records itself (see design/builds/engine-v3/builds)

Lit at Dusk.rule: Furnace of the Evening Glow (Mộ Quang Lô): after the fight's 20th second the furnace burns hotter: healing-over-time stacks (Wood buff stacks) the holder grants are 20 % stronger for the rest of the fight.

Lit but Not Launched.rule: Stern Lamp of the Evening Boats: extends every Fishing Boats Sing at Dusk art by 2 s (Coming Home at Dusk 6 to 8 s, Oars Together 4 to 6 s with 5 s curse clamp, The Ninth Verse 10 to 12 s).

Lost on the Road.rule: Passive art (mist-lock-array-canon L5; authored wish d2): each foe art that misses you, evaded or avoided, while your mist field is up adds one Lost; at five, your escape art comes ready at once and cannot fail, and the Lost are spent.
Lost on the Road.approx: timer lacks a tag filter in engine.py so cooldown reset uses which: 'all' (-99 s) alongside setting lost_ready = 1 (+100 escape mod until an escape art fires; escape_channel still respects bound/escape_max 0.95).

Marked Prey.rule: Your hits deal more for each different status of yours on the target: L5 +4 each, cap +16.

Master's Road.rule: Step for Step, full set (2 pieces): while your ward holds (your stance ward, or your main ward, which stands while you have linh lực), the Ice stacks you lay last twice as long.

Measured Flood.rule: Rain-Measure Gourd: Water field floods you lay (Open the Sluice or any Water field art) last 3 s longer (+3 flood_sec), and when the flood ends the foe keeps its slow (3 stacks of Slowed Time) for 1 more second.

Metal Begets Water.rule: Each hit of a Metal art you land adds one Water buff stack to you. Closes: Wood arts you slot deal 50 % less.
Metal Begets Water.engine_choice: the stack lasts 10 s, a typical Water art's buff batch

Moistens Without a Sound.rule: Canon of the Good Rain (passive art, unlock layer 4): each heal restored to you (at most 3 a pulse) adds 1 Wood buff stack for 8 s.

Moon on Open Water.rule: Mirror of the Long Lake Moon: while Composed, your Water arts deal 12 % more damage and cast 15 % faster.
Moon on Open Water.approx: Depth prose mentions 'reach twice as far' while still for 2 s; in non-spatial combat mapped cleanly to own.composed >= 1 granting Water art_speed +15 and Water dmg_more +0.12.

Moss Ledger.rule: Poison stacks you lay cannot be cleansed for their first 4 s.

Mountain's Weight.rule: Your hits deal L5 +4 for each 10 % of maximum health you hold above the foe's, cap +32. Closes: art speed -20 %.

Needle of Mending.rule: Sweet Dew Needles: your needle arts heal you for the damage they deal and clear 1 debuff stack (authored wish a1; loadout strike-skip is not modelled, so the hit still strikes and triggers on hit_landed for needle-tagged arts and Needle Rain).
Needle of Mending.approx: Loadout toggle ('instead of striking') is not modelled: needle arts still deal damage and heal for event.amount + cleanse 1 debuff stack on hit_landed; matches both tags:['needle'] and art_id:'needle-rain' (common-arts.json omits the needle tag).

Never the Eighth.rule: The Seven Movements, full set (3 pieces): each movement of the Remnant Score you play lays one Slowed Time stack. When you play the seventh in a fight, the foe takes 5 Slowed Time stacks, and the score begins again from the first with your soul arts 20 % faster. There is no eighth.

Nine Cups.rule: The Founder's Rain-Chain: Each time you are hit, one of nine bronze cups fills. When all nine are full, your next art is cast at once and costs no linh lực, and the cups empty.
Nine Cups.approx: Exact engine form using own.counter.nine_cups incremented on was_hit; on reaching 9, resets and runs timer next -99 + next_art_cost 0.0 (cost multiplier 0 = free).

Nine Squares.rule: Out of a fight, the seal unfolds into a nine-square spirit field wherever it is pressed into soil; it carries the soil of the sect's fields with it (craft rule).
Nine Squares.not_run: Out-of-fight field-craft Effect only; no combat rule.

Nine Stars over the Fire.rule: Canopy Furnace (Hoa Cái Lô): in a fight, while a foe carries any of your debuffs, your wards gain +20 % ward strength and your stance ward regains 2 % of its peak each second. Out-of-fight pill refining batch-preservation awaits alchemy crafting Effect hooks.
Nine Stars over the Fire.approx: Out-of-fight failed-batch preservation has no crafting Effect hook in src/ yet; fight half runs live (+20 % ward_pct and 2 % peak ward_grow while the foe carries Earth, Metal, Wood, Fire, Ice, Thunder, or Wind debuffs).

Ninety Thousand Li.rule: The Last of Phù Dao, full set (3 pieces): each blow you evade winds the whirlwind tighter, granting 1 Wind buff stack for 8 s. When you cast a Wind escape or footwork art (tagged escape or step) with 8 or more Wind buff stacks, you spend them all on a gust: for 2 s the foe's hits on you deal 20 % less (dampen_taken 25), and you gain 2.5 % evasion for 4 s for each stack spent.
Ninety Thousand Li.approx: Matches Wind arts tagged escape or step so Thôi Dương Giác's Gale Courier footwork arts (three-step-chase, swallow-stance) trigger the gust alongside any Wind escape art (no Wind escape art exists in the library yet).

Nirvana.rule: Once per fight, the blow that would kill you leaves you at 30 % health instead. Closes: healing taken -30 %.

No Hiding on the Quay.rule: Cold Ford Watch (3 pieces): a foe that cannot evade loses its concealment, and each second it cannot evade your next Wood art against it deals 8 % more; that art spends the bonus, and it is lost when it can evade again.

No Second Cut.rule: Dạ Lan, the Sword of the Late Night: Your first sword hit on the foe in a fight is a guaranteed crit and pierces their guard; your later hits on the foe deal a little less.
No Second Cut.approx: Tracks no_second_done (cap 1): while 0, grants sure_crit: 1, bypass: 0.5 (50 % shield bypass), and pen: 150 (150 resistance penetration) to sword arts; on hit_landed (sword art), sets no_second_done = 1; while 1, later sword arts deal dmg_more: -0.10. Return to the Scabbard or One Cut Drawn Out can re-arm it.

No Ward.rule: You can never use a ward, and your body hardens instead: body shield +25 %; after each pulse in which no hit reached your health, the body shield regains 2 % of maximum health. Closes: no ward of any kind.

Nobody Falls.rule: Poria Under Pine (3 pieces): once a fight, a heal that lands on you while you are below a quarter of your health also gives you a Wood ward worth 10 % of your health.

Nobody Looked.rule: Road Mist (2 pieces: va-mist-lock-lantern, va-milestone-flag): while your mist formation holds, the first art aimed at you every 8 s misses; the mist holds 3 s longer.
Nobody Looked.approx: Adds +3 to mist_field once per active mist field on first pulse (avoids art_fired listener-order dependence); grants 1 decoy every 8 s via pulse cooldown (hit() consumes decoy on next direct attack since decoys cannot filter strictly to kind: 'art').

None Shall Pass.rule: The Gate, full set (3 pieces): after you block three hits, your next sword thrust is a sure crit, bypasses half of ward shields (bypass 0.5), and ignores 100 resistance points.
None Shall Pass.approx: Uses bypass 0.5 (the engine's bypass_cap) + pen 100 on the next sword-tagged hit.

Not One Lamp Out.rule: The Lamp Chain, full set (3 pieces: vtd-unsleeping-lamp, vtd-kim-sa-seal, vtd-pearl-diver-robe): while you cast no escape art, your ward seals do not burn out, and each seal that turns a blow passes one more turn to the next seal in the line (+1 % ward strength per passed turn). If you cast an escape art, every seal burns out after 3 s.

Not a Drop Spilled.rule: Rain-Chain Sword Scripture (passive art, layer 4, authored wish d10): Each second in which you fire no damaging art fills a bronze cup: each cup raises your linh lực regeneration by 5 %. Your next art with a damage part spends every cup for 3 % more damage each.
Not a Drop Spilled.approx: Tracks damaging-art pulses via not_a_drop_acted (immune to evades and non-damaging arts); each cup grants regen +0.00175 (= 5 * 0.00035, +5 % linh_luc_regen_inc_pct); spends all Cups via 1 ms temp_mod L5 (+3 per Cup, scoped to kind: art) on damaging art_fired (not_tags: movement, own.since_act <= 0).

Nothing False Survives.rule: Hundred-Fold Crucible (ck-hundred-fold-crucible): every buff, ward or borrowed stat a foe gains while near you burns off twice as fast. You can tell whether any item you are shown is what its owner says it is.
Nothing False Survives.approx: "burns off twice as fast" is modelled as ward_bill +100 (foe drain ward burns linh lực 2x as fast) and stripping 1 buff stack every 2 s; out-of-fight item appraisal sentence is lore

One Cut Drawn Out.rule: The Undefeated, full set: each second you go without attacking adds 12 % crit damage to your next sword art. The first sword art of each fight cannot be evaded. Return to the Scabbard (Quy Sao): after 3 s in which you fire no damaging art, the foe counts as unstruck again: No Second Cut and the first-art clause re-arm.
One Cut Drawn Out.approx: Tracks pulses without a damaging art via drawn_acted + drawn_idle (immune to evades and non-damaging arts, separate from Return to the Scabbard's counters so both compose cleanly). Adds 1 drawn_out per idle pulse, spent on next damaging sword art via 1 ms temp_mod crit_mult +12 each (scoped to kind: art, tags: [sword]). First damaging sword art grants 1 ms acc: 500 (cannot be evaded); 3 idle pulses re-arm first_sword_done and no_second_done.

One Goose.rule: Standard of the First File: the standard is raised at the start of the fight; while it stands you take 15 % less damage, and every 6 s it takes the first share of the next blow that deals health damage (30 % of the hit healed back).

One Stick of Listening.rule: Pine-Heart Censer: out of combat, disciples who sit in its smoke for the listening cultivate 10 % faster that season.
One Stick of Listening.not_run: Out-of-combat seasonal cultivation is outside fight simulations (Sect & Cultivation host).

One Thread of Wind.rule: Horse Lord of the Plain, full set (3 pieces): each time you (art or basic) and your companion land hits within 1 s, you heal 2 % of your health (companions have no health bar, Combat rule 19) and gain 1 Wind buff stack for 10 s (once a pulse). At 5 or more Wind stacks, your next Physical art hit spends 5 Wind stacks to knock the foe down for 1 s (foe clock stops 1 s and Off Guard 1 s). Your companion's hits deal 15 % more against a foe bearing any of your statuses.

Open Sky.rule: Your wards are 5 % stronger for each extra item slot you leave empty. Closes (tree keystone): artifact power -30 %.

Opening Cut.rule: When a Physical hit of yours crits, it applies one Bleed stack, once per hit.

Out of the Mist.rule: Bobtail Axe: your first hit after your mist field ends strikes 20 % harder. By the sect's rule it is never struck while the mist is up.
Out of the Mist.approx: Tracks mist_field active -> 0 transitions on pulse, art_fired, was_hit, and evaded (so even a mid-pulse lift or Lantern-Stone break arms immediately), applies +20 % dmg_more (0.2) only while mist_field == 0, and spends the charge on hit_landed.

Outlast the Grey.rule: The Miasma Watch, full set (3 pieces): each poison or miasma stack the Lantern sheds heals you 1 % of your health over 3 s (0.33 % per pulse) and loads 1 Earth stack onto your next anchor hit (Anchor Drop). When you lay an Earth stack that brings the foe to 6 or more Earth stacks, its clock stops for 1.5 s and it is Bound for 2 s (once every 12 s).
Outlast the Grey.approx: non-spatial lock: 'locked in place for 1.5 s' is stop_clock 1.5 s plus Bound 2 s; poison-faded stacks are fed by The Flame Turns Green

Overheat.rule: Art speed that cooldown_min clips on an art becomes L5 on that art, point for point, cap +30. Closes (tree keystone): your art costs +35 %.

Owed Water.rule: When your linh luc falls to 20 % of maximum or below, you regain 15 % of your maximum linh luc over the next 5 s. Once every 20 s.
Owed Water.approx: checked once a pulse; +3 pp regeneration for 5 s (log-shaped like every regeneration bonus, so slightly under 15 %)

Pack Hunt.rule: Your companion's hits deal more to a target bearing any of your statuses: L5 +15, scope companion.

Paid in Advance.rule: Your talismans cost no linh luc when they fire. Closes: you may slot only talismans, wards and the escape art.
Paid in Advance.approx: cost reduction stops at the engine's 95 %; the slot rule is the build's to keep

Paint It Back.rule: The Idle Cloud (Nhàn Vân Tam Bảo), full set (3 pieces): when your reflection-double falls (by timeout or ward break), the Plain Silk Scroll keeps the ward it grew (scroll_ward) and gives it to you as a stance ward; and the first time each fight your health falls to half or below, you regain 4 % + 3.5 % per hit taken in the last 3 s of your max health and 4 % + 4 % per art fired in the last 3 s of your max linh lực.
Paint It Back.approx: Because engine own.lost_last.hp.3 / qi.3 return raw points rather than shares and heal/gain_qi scale on hp_max/qi_max or event.amount, the 3 s rewind restores 4 % + 3.5 % max HP per hit/tick received in the last 3 s (hits_3s) and 4 % + 4 % max linh lực per distinct art fired in the last 3 s (own.fired_within.3.all).

Paper Laid at Dawn.rule: The Dawn Half, full set (3 pieces): talismans you lay cost no linh lực up to the engine's 95 % cap until they fire, and for every 10 s a laid talisman stays unspent you gain 1 Dawn Growth: each growth gives your talisman arts 10 % more damage and 1 extra Wood stack on hit (once per firing), and costs 2 % of your maximum linh lực when a talisman fires.
Paper Laid at Dawn.approx: cost reduction stops at cost_red_cap (0.95); growth ticks by laid_talisman talisman-seconds per pulse (converting every 10 s into +1 dawn_growth), scales all talisman arts, and subtracts 2 % max linh lực per growth when a talisman fires while qi_share >= 0.06.

Petal Feint.rule: Yellow Chrysanthemums, full set (2 pieces): after you evade a hit, your next fan art fires 30 % faster and its Burns last 2 s longer.
Petal Feint.approx: +2 s on 6 s Burn batches modelled as stack_dur +33 % on Fire debuffs for that next fan art's firing

Phantom Dodge.rule: Each basic attack of yours that lands counts as an evade for your arts' counters and held payloads, at most twice a pulse. Closes: you evade 10 pp less.

Phoenix Mend.rule: When you restore health with an art, the enemy gains 1 Burn stack for each 1 % of your maximum health restored, at most 6 a pulse, at your Burn's values.
Phoenix Mend.approx: any heal counts, not only art heals; Burn lasts 6 s

Pines in Ten Thousand Ravines.rule: Pine-Wind Zither (vh-tung-phong-cam): Each song art you play echoes once on the next pulse as a 0.8 c Force strike (about half a note's strength) and adds 1 Resonance stack to the foe. Echoes cannot themselves echo.

Planted Banner.rule: Your Earth parts deal 2 % more for every 4 Earth buff stacks you hold.

Planted, Waited, Harvested.rule: The Back Garden, full set (3 pieces): once Wood Poison has lasted 6 s on the foe, your Wood Poison grants double-stack (+1 stack per grant). Once a fight when a Wood art (other than Gather More) lands on a foe with 6+ Wood stacks after 6 s of poison, you harvest all Wood stacks for immediate Chaos damage (0.15 per stack) and heal 0.5 % max health per stack.
Planted, Waited, Harvested.approx: Tracks elapsed seconds of Wood Poison on the foe (garden_ripe_t >= 6) rather than per-batch age, doubles single-stack grants via stack_grant +1 [wood, debuff], and fires the one-time harvest on a Wood art hit.

Playing Past the Break.rule: Shao Remnant Score (technique Effect, authored e4): Once a fight, firing Remnant Score's Next Movement right after its seventh attempts the eighth movement via a counted-chance meter (p = (thần hồn + khí vận) / 400). Success: 5 Slowed Time (5 s) on foe and +10 % linh lực. Failure: −10 % health and −10 % linh lực backlash. Restarts score at first either way.
Playing Past the Break.approx: failure −10 % health and −10 % linh lực backlash are paid on the next pulse via 1 % upkeep counters (exact own max HP/linh lực at any realm gap, leaving pay_keep_health)

Plucked Time.rule: When one of your song arts lands a soul hit, the enemy's next ready art is delayed by 0.4 s, at most once a second. Closes: your arts that are neither soul nor song deal 15 % less.
Plucked Time.approx: the closing is not run (a filter cannot say 'neither soul nor song')

Price on the Ribs.rule: Fan of the Evening Market: when the fan's art (Fan Gust) lands on a foe carrying Earth stacks, your hits ignore 25 resistance points for 4 s per Earth stack the foe carries (approximating -5 % defence per Earth stack on a ~500-point typical ward, no cap).
Price on the Ribs.approx: the engine cannot apply a negative defence mod to the foe, so -5 % defence per Earth stack is modelled as resistance penetration +25 points per Earth stack on the holder for 4 s

Quench the Jacket.rule: Snow-Melt Gourd: when you take Fire damage (once every 2 s), you gain 1 Water buff stack for 10 s; while you hold 3 or more Water buff stacks, your own Burn stacks on you are cleansed 1 every 2 s.
Quench the Jacket.approx: Incoming debuff duration halving is not a live mod key, so periodic 2 s Fire cleanse while holding 3+ Water buff stacks models Burn ending twice as fast (following The Robe Is Never Dry).

Rain That Does Not Stop.rule: The Grain Rain, full set (3 pieces): once your healing rain begins, it stays on the field until you fall. For every 10 s it has fallen, you gain +10 % healing and pay 1 % of your maximum health each second (unreduced upkeep).
Rain That Does Not Stop.approx: +10 healing per 10 s of rain applies to all incoming heals rather than only the rain field's pulse heal.

Rain on the Leaves.rule: Founder's Bamboo Staff: While you keep Pressing, the foe's art that hits you gives you one Walk Slowly stack, as if you had walked a second longer.

Rain on the Sown Field.rule: The Herb Terraces, full set (3 pieces): while your Grain Rain falls, Lingzhi Spores on the foe do not fade, and each time a spore stack ripens it heals you for 2 % of your health.

Reach and Root.rule: Evening Ferry (2 pieces): a foe that cannot evade from a pole art of yours stays so 1 s longer for each 3 Wood stacks it carries, and that spends those stacks; each time the foe is made unable to evade this way again in a fight, the extra time is halved.
Reach and Root.approx: Uses `status_dur` (+100 % first, +50 % second, +25 % third+ per 3 Wood stacks on foe) when `off_guard` lands (from any source, since tv-punt-pole uses the base common art under R6) and consumes all Wood stacks on the foe (engine `consume` takes a fixed count, not scaled).

Read Aloud.rule: The Reader's Pair, full set (2 pieces): ringing the bell (at fight start and when struck, 6 s cooldown) opens a 6 s window; each soul art you cast within it gets +25 % status duration (~1 s longer, up to the 5 s curse cap), and on your third such art your soul art speed surges (+1000 % soul art speed) so your next soul art casts at once (at the 1 s soul lockout).
Read Aloud.approx: vk-empty-hall-bell uses Golden Bell (a standing per-hit ward with no active ring), so ringing the bell is triggered at fight_start and on was_hit (6 s cooldown) for 6.5 s (covering exact 6 s casts), status duration uses +25 % status_dur (clamped by curse_duration_max = 5 on lamp-oil-lance's 5 s slackened_soul), and on read_aloud >= 2 while bell_ring >= 1 an always-on soul-tagged art_speed +1000 % fires the next soul art at cooldown_min / 1 s soul lockout before resetting read_aloud at 3.

Red Cloud Rising.rule: Red Cloud Banner (pvd-xich-ha-ky): in a duel (rewritten from 'allies within its cloud' per the one-side-against-one-side ruling, 2026-11-26), every 3 s you gain 1 Fire buff stack of fury (15 s, raising attack) and 1 self-Burn stack (6 s, burning you for a little health each second and feeding Burning Feather heat). Once a fight, if you would go Down and are not already wearing the full Standing in the Fire set (which overrides with a 33 % rise), you rise at 20 % of your maximum health.

Reflection.rule: After you evade, your next art deals L5 +15, once per evade.

Return to the Scabbard.rule: Rain-Chain Sword Scripture (passive art, layer 6, authored wish d29): After 3 s in which you fire no damaging art, the foe counts as unstruck again: your pieces that read your first hit on a foe, or your first sword art of the fight, re-arm, and any later-hit penalty clears. Your first sword art on an unstruck foe cannot be evaded.
Return to the Scabbard.approx: Tracks consecutive pulses without a damaging art via scabbard_acted + scabbard_idle (immune to evades and non-damaging arts); at 3 idle pulses resets no_second_done and first_sword_done. Grants 1 ms acc: 500 on first damaging sword art_fired (guarantees p_ev == 0 without stealing a curse slot or failing to status_resist).

Returning Wave.rule: The first hit you take in each fight does you no harm and strikes the foe instead, at full damage. Closes: maximum health -15 %.
Returning Wave.engine_choice: the hit's damage before your defence strikes the foe through its defence

Rider and King.rule: Rider of the Green Field, full set (2 pieces): while a bonded crane companion fights with you, each attack you evade is answered by one Wind strike at the attacker (0.6 coefficient Force free hit, at most once a second), and you regain 1 % of your health each second.
Rider and King.approx: Latches king_beside on the first crane-tagged companion hit or evade (Thanh Điền in the world export) because the engine has no live own.companions readable.

Rime Lock.rule: When your Ice stacks on a target reach 10, that target's art with the least time left is delayed by 1 s, once per 4 pulses per target.

Ring Within the Ring.rule: Rings of the Armillary, full set (3 pieces): a Ring of the Hour you lay while your ring (a Field) is up becomes a second ring; while you hold both, the foe is Bound (it cannot flee) and takes your array damage once for each ring every second (+25 % array ring damage while two rings hold).
Ring Within the Ring.approx: Ring of the Hour already lays stacked ring summons by default, so the 3-piece set adds Bound plus +25 % companion/ring dmg_more while two or more rings hold

Rings as It Moves.rule: Singing Luan Bell (Minh Loan Linh): whenever the foe presses (acts or is Pressing, read each second) or dodges (evades your hit), the bell rings for a 0.4 Physical hit and 1 Metal debuff stack for 8 s, at most once per second.

Rising Tide.rule: While your linh lực is above half, your Water stacks count double. Closes: while it is below half, your Water stacks do nothing.
Rising Tide.engine_choice: your own Water buff stacks; the half reads linh lực without the stacks' own pool bonus

Roll Up the Western Rain.rule: The Dusk Half, full set (3 pieces): when the foe is Broken, or sheds your Wood stacks (by cleanse or natural expiry), each stack shed heals you for 1 % of your health and removes 1 debuff stack.
Roll Up the Western Rain.approx: cleansed in the engine carries only event.amount with no element field, so eff:Roll Up the Western Rain cleanse triggers on any debuff stack or curse cleansed by the foe.

Roots Under the Field.rule: Banner of the Coiled Roots: when the foe has been Composed for 2 s, it cannot evade for 1 s; once every 10 s.

Sap Rises.rule: Each Wood buff stack you hold adds 1 % healing, up to 20 %.

Scatter Gale.rule: When you evade, you cleanse your own debuff stacks, at most 2 batches every 6 s.

Sea Already Deep.rule: You begin every fight with 8 Water buff stacks that last the whole fight. Closes: your arts cost 10 % more linh luc.

Seal and Weight in One Hand.rule: Regalia of the Pivot, full set: once each fight, when a foe below half its health carries 5 or more Earth stacks (Weights), it is judged: its clock stops for 2 s (the stun), its largest buff pile is stripped (its strongest buff), and its guard is broken open (Exposed for 4 s, the engine's reading of "its wards broken"). While you hold all three, your own ward holds half as much (one who judges alone stands alone).
Seal and Weight in One Hand.approx: "its wards broken" is Exposed for 4 s; "strongest buff" is its largest buff pile

Seal of Full Payment.rule: Your arts and wards are paid in carried spirit stones.
Seal of Full Payment.not_run: carried spirit stones are not in the sim

Sealed Cask.rule: Seal of the Hundred Jars: a foe struck by your Water art while carrying three or more of your Water stacks gains one Drunk stack and one Heavy Breath.

Sealed Writ.rule: North Star Seal: the first foe you strike with a seal art each fight (the first seal-tagged hit that lands) is Sealed for 4 s: its guard is broken open (Exposed, the engine's reading of "its wards hold half their value") and each second its largest buff pile is stripped (the engine's reading of "it cannot gain new buffs").
Sealed Writ.approx: "wards hold half their value" is Exposed (-100 resistance, 4 s); "cannot gain new buffs" is a strip of its largest buff pile each second for 4 s

Second Wind on the Ice.rule: Ice-Fisher's Three, full set: the first time each fight you fall to half your health, you regain 20 % of your health and a quarter of your linh lực over 4 s, and your next five Snow Plum arts each lay one more Ice stack.
