Seen in the Water.rule: Mirror of the Star-Fallen Lake: at the start of a fight you see the first art the foe will use. The first time the foe uses it (the first foe art that lands), you ward it fully (restore all health lost to it) and mark the foe for The Field Turns.
Seen in the Water.approx: the first foe art to land is warded in full via 100 % amount heal instead of matching a specific future art id

Sentence Stands.rule: Bridge Court Pair, full set (2 pieces): a curse you lay on a foe who carries your Weight (an Earth stack) cannot be cleansed and lasts 2 s longer (status duration +50 % for curses, about 2 s on the 4 s curses; the 5 s clamp holds).

Serve a Term.rule: Contract Sword Canon (layer 1): each pulse you are Pressing (or evade an attack, at most 1 per pulse) and landed no art hit serves 1 Term (Khoản); each enemy art hit you take strikes 1 Term off.
Serve a Term.approx: Tracks art hits on hit_landed/was_evaded (filter kind: art) rather than basic attacks (matching Return to the Scabbard and The Called Blow); caps Terms served via term_served at 1 per pulse across Pressing and evaded, and strips 1 Term on enemy art hits (was_hit, filter kind: art, cooldown 3.0 s) so basic attacks do not zero out Terms every second.

Seven Lamps Turn.rule: Seven-Star Array Flag: each formation art you fire (an art tagged formation, such as The Pivot Does Not Turn or Plant the Stele) lights one of seven star-lamps. At the seventh, your ward holds twice as much for 5 s (the engine's reading of "your next ward is doubled") and the foe gains 2 Earth stacks for 10 s; then the lamps go out.

Shattering Ward.rule: When one of your shields breaks, it bursts against the enemy: free Force hit, c_trig 0.6, 1 a pulse, 3 a fight.

Shield Pays the Blood.rule: Health that your arts would cost is paid from your body shield first, point for point; once the shield is gone, health pays again. Closes: your healing is 20 % weaker.

Silence After the Twelfth.rule: The Monk's Things, full set (3 pieces): each echo the Zither sounds adds one Resonance to its foe; when you stop playing (The Held Rest), a foe with 6 or more Resonance falls into the silence: its clock stops for 1 s and its casting is 30 % slower for 3 s.
Silence After the Twelfth.approx: Uses stop_clock (foe, 1.0 s) + Slowed Time x5 (30 % slower, 3 s) instead of single-tag Silence so all foe arts stall and slow.

Sit Beside.rule: Ash-Seat Censer (pm-ash-seat-censer): A member of the holder's sect who attempts a breakthrough beside the lit censer has heart-demon odds cut by a quarter, and a failed attempt leaves no meridian scar.
Sit Beside.not_run: out-of-fight breakthrough rule: no part in a combat duel

Sit and Watch.rule: Robe of the Rising Clouds (vk-rising-cloud-robe): while you have not moved for 3 s (Composed 3 s), you take 12 % less damage (dampen_taken 13.64), and each time statuses end on you, you recover 2 % linh lực and +6 % soul resistance for 4 s.
Sit and Watch.approx: engine has no status_ended event or restore_than_thuc action; a pulse watcher detects active statuses clearing on you and grants gain_qi 2 % + soul_res 6 for 4 s.

Sit as Thôi Sat.rule: The Empty Mountain, full set (3 pieces): every 5 s you are Composed, you bank 1 Cloud; when you hold 5 or more Clouds, the next damaging hit on you is answered by a free hundred-echo palm (1.5 c Physical) that echoes once (+0.6 c Physical) for each Cloud spent.

Sitting on the Ice.rule: Fisher's Heirs, full set (2 pieces): after 2 s Composed, you regenerate 1.5 % of your health and linh lực each second, and your next sword cut lays 2 Ice stacks.

Sky Iron Sings.rule: Three Years' Tax (tht-three-years-tax): when a Thunder art strikes you or your blade (or Heat the Edge quenches), the sword rings: your next 3 Metal art hits deal extra Thunder damage (0.45 c Lightning free hit).
Sky Iron Sings.approx: extra Thunder damage is modelled as a 0.45 c Lightning free hit on each of your next 3 Metal art hits.

Slack Water.rule: Shell of the Claw King: when you block a hit, gain 1 Water buff stack (8 s); at 5 Water buff stacks (4 with The Tenth Layer), your next Still Moon Tide art heals you for 4 % of your health.

Sold.rule: Seal of the Land's Riches: when Hammer Price spends 10 or more Metal stacks on a foe, the seal strikes the foe's ward as well: the foe loses 25 % of its maximum linh lực and you gain a stance ward of 25 % of your maximum health.
Sold.approx: the foe's ward loss is modelled as burn_qi of 25 % of its maximum linh lực (weakening its main drain ward); the gained ward is a stance ward of 25 % max health.

Somewhere Else by Morning.rule: The Crossing, full set (3 pieces): each time you evade, gain 1 Water buff stack (8 s); while you hold 5 or more Water buff stacks, your next evade spends 5 of them to raise a tide that heals you 5 % of your health (1 % per stack spent) each second for 5 s.

Span the Gap.rule: Cloud Bridge Flags: raises 2 Flag charges (12 s each) at fight start, and each Earth art you fire adds 1 Flag charge (12 s, once every 4 s). While you hold 2 or more Flag charges, damage you take is dampened by 10 % and every 3 s your stance ward grows by 3 % of your maximum health (created if you hold none).

Spillover.rule: Your ticks also burn the target's linh luc, 25 % of the damage each deals after resistance.

Spirit Garden.rule: Herbs in your spirit fields ripen a season sooner. Closes: you can keep at most one spirit beast.
Spirit Garden.not_run: spirit fields and seasons are outside fights (Spirit Herbs & Spirit Fields host); its closing waits with it

Steady Breath.rule: While your linh luc is at 50 % or above, arts in this piece's scope deal more: L5 +12, scope set by the host.
Steady Breath.approx: unscoped here; a build whose host sets a scope writes its own record

Step Before the Strike.rule: Son of Thủ Lôi Bảo, full set (2 pieces): each time you evade, your next staff strike cannot be blocked and lands an additional Lightning shock worth 30 % of its damage.
Step Before the Strike.approx: Engine has no live damage-conversion mod (convert is static on ArtDef). Approximates '30 % of its damage as Lightning' by keeping the full unblocked staff strike (1 ms ignore_block: 1 on staff art_fired, since defend reads ignore_block with ctx=None) and adding a Lightning shock (return_damage share: 0.30, dtype: lightning) on staff hit_landed so Walk Slowly stacks and crits still scale it cleanly.

Still Water.rule: Linh lực lost to a full pool restores health at half that amount. Closes (tree keystone): healing taken from every other source -50 %.

Stone Answers.rule: When your body shield or a ward stops damage, you strike back with a free Physical hit worth 25 % of the damage stopped, at most 6 % of your maximum health per pulse.
Stone Answers.not_run: a free hit sized by damage stopped needs a hit by amount, which the engine's free_hit (a coefficient) does not take

Strangling Vines.rule: Each time the foe reaches 5 Wood debuff stacks, it is Slowed Time for 1 s (once per 6 s). Closes: art speed -15 %.

Struck, She Rings.rule: Pendant and Bell, full set (3 pieces): each hit you take rings the Luan Bell as though the attacker had moved (a 0.4 Physical hit and 1 Metal debuff stack for 8 s), and the Jade Pendants chime back to heal you for 1 % of maximum health, at most once per second.

Sun That Never Sets.rule: Each season you cultivate, you also gain 1 point of đạo tâm (+10 per realm). Closes: you can never conceal yourself; heart-demon resistance -30 %.
Sun That Never Sets.not_run: seasons and đạo tâm are outside fights (Cultivation / Time & Turn host); its closings wait with it

Sun and Rain.rule: Your health regeneration also restores linh lực, at half the amount (as a share of each pool). Closes: maximum linh lực -30 %.

Supple as a Swimming Dragon.rule: Wandering Dragon Sash: once every 15 s, when a single hit would take more than a tenth of your health, you slip half of it.
Supple as a Swimming Dragon.approx: was_hit passes raw amount without share and hp_max varies by realm; threshold set to 6000 HP (exact 10 % of Thôi Khinh Hồng's 60,348 Hóa Thần health) and restores 50 % of event.amount (scaled by healing %) while logging dragon_slipped for Swan Goose and Swimming Dragon.

Sword Chorus.rule: Your sword artifact arts deal 6 % more for each other equipped artifact that gives you a sword art, with no cap. Closes: your arts that are not sword arts deal 15 % less.
Sword Chorus.approx: applies to every sword art, not only artifact ones; the closing is not run (a filter cannot say 'not sword')

Take the Wind.rule: Point of the File, full set (2 pieces): you take 10 % less damage, and each block you make raises a stance ward worth 1.5 % of your health.

Ten Thousand Poisons.rule: Your Poison batches last until the fight ends. Closes: your hits deal 25 % less.

Ten Thousand Swords Return.rule: Your sword arts deal L5 +8 for each sword artifact you carry, cap +32. Closes: only arts with the sword tag may be slotted; your wards are 30 % weaker.

The Army That Waits.rule: The Armoured Horse, full set (2 pieces): once a fight, at its start, the riders join you as a summon for 10 s (a Physical strike of 0.6 every 2 s); the first companion or summon hit after they join makes the foe's soonest art wait 0.5 s. Outside a fight, the pair opens Thiết Mã Cảnh and commands the army in it: a world event, not a stat (not run here).
The Army That Waits.approx: the riders are a summon (0.6 every 2 s for 10 s); the realm half is a world event

The Called Blow.rule: Army-Breaker Spear (authored wish d21): after 3 s in which you strike nothing (no damaging or movement art and no evade, the Composed clock; your companions', summons' and the basic attack's hits do not count), your next spear art is a certain crit and ignores block. The Called Thrust.rule: Army-Breaker's Harness, full set: each full second in which you strike nothing (no damaging or movement art and no evade: the Composed clock, Combat rule 25) lays 1 Earth stack for 12 s on the foe. The Army-Breaker's waited thrust (The Seventh Star Falls) spends them all as it fires, before it strikes; if it spends 5 or more, it first breaks the foe's guard entirely: Exposed for 4 s, laid before its hit lands (the engine's reading of "breaks the foe's ward entirely"). The engine cannot tell which Earth stacks the waiting laid, so the thrust counts and spends every Earth stack on the foe, the Pivot's Weights too.
The Called Thrust.approx: "breaks the foe's ward entirely" is Exposed for 4 s; "them all" is every Earth stack on the foe, not only those the waiting laid

The Empty Mountain's Answer.rule: Healing lost to your full health is stored as Green, and the Green fades by a tenth each second. When the foe cannot evade or carries 5 or more of your Wood stacks, the Green falls on it as Wood damage, once every 3 s.

The Field Turns.rule: Pole Star Court, full set (2 pieces): while your array field is up and you are Composed, every 4 s the foe gains one Earth stack and its soonest art waits 0.3 s. The Five Marks Shine.rule: Robe of the Five Marks (pm-five-colour-robe): Each time you spend a full five-colour plumage, you gain a ward equal to 6 % of your health for 4 s.

The Line Is Tuned.rule: Bells on the Roads, full set (3 pieces): your ward bells are linked. The Struck Shed.rule: Gold Sand and Lightning, full set: while your sword is raised to the cloud, each bolt it draws that crits adds a Lightning stack on the foe.
The Struck Shed.approx: Exact engine form: listens on crit for sword-raised-to-the-cloud while own.counter.sword_raised >= 1 and adds 1 Thunder debuff stack.

The Tenth Layer.rule: Slack Water, full set (3 pieces): the Shell's heal arms at 4 Water buff stacks instead of 5, each heal the Shell makes also grants 1 Water buff stack (8 s), and while you block, your Water buff stacks refresh their duration.

The Thread Catches.rule: Red Cloud Shuttle (chc-red-cloud-shuttle): when a foe is bound by two of the holder's threads at once, both threads catch fire: 2 Fire stacks (6 s) and a short burn (1 Fire stack for 3 s).

The Treasury Key.rule: Lone Duck Ring: once per fight, when you fall to half health or below, you gain a stance ward equal to 20 % of your maximum health (created if you hold none). Out of fights, opens Lạc Hà's treasury arrays at the seat.

The Twelve Hours.rule: Armillary Array Canon, passive art from layer 4 (authored wish d16): the armillary counts the fight in hours of 5 s, and each ring belongs to the hour it was laid. A ring deals 30 % more within its own hour. When rings of three different hours stand at once, the armillary turns: every ring is refreshed (Earth stacks refreshed and a fresh 12 s ring pulse joins), and each further hour beyond two adds 6 % more damage and 1 Slowed Time stack on the foe each second.
The Twelve Hours.approx: within-its-own-hour +30 % applies to companion/ring hits whenever any ring was laid in the current 5 s hour (summons carry no laid-hour tag); the armillary turn refreshes foe Earth debuffs and adds a 12 s ring summon (10 s cooldown) instead of mutating live each_for timestamps so charge_hours stays intact

The Unfinished Pill.rule: Nine-Cycle Gourd (Cửu Chuyển Hồ Lô): once a fight (at 75 % health or below, or from 8 s), drink from the gourd: heal a third of your health and gain +30 attack points for 10 s, then take 4 lingering uncleansable Poison stacks until the fight ends (sent to the foe instead when A Room Full of Fume is active).

The Unplayed Note.rule: The Stringless Zither of Cầm Tượng (vh-stringless-zither): While you hold the Monk's Rest silence, this zither plays the note you did not: the next song art you cast after the silence ends costs no linh lực.

The Weakest File.rule: Drum, Flag and Spear, full set: each time the drum strikes (Beat to Quarters fires), the foe is marked as the weak file for 6 s; while it is marked, your spear arts and your companions' and summons' strikes pierce its resistances (40 resistance points ignored, about a fifth of a same-realm foe's). "The foe with the least health" and "when it dies the drum strikes again" fall away in a one-against-one fight.
The Weakest File.approx: "a fifth of its resistances" is 40 resistance points (pen); the multi-foe clauses are dropped

The Wick Is Cut.rule: Lamp and Shears of the Vaults, full set: once a fight, a cursed foe below a quarter of their health has their curse turned into a seal: they cannot cast arts for 2 s.
The Wick Is Cut.approx: Uses stop_clock (foe, 2.0 s) once per fight on pulse when foe.hp_share <= 0.25 and foe.curses >= 1 (engine status `silence` requires a single art tag, whereas stop_clock blocks all arts for 2 s as in bang_tam's The Keeper's Stillness).

The Wind Lifts the Mist.rule: Passive art (road-mist-primer L1, mist-lock-array-canon L1; authored wish d49): when the foe fires an art with the wind element tag, it lifts one mist of yours: your newest Field tagged mist ends, or your mist self-state (A Breath of Road Mist) if you have no mist Field. If a Lantern-Stone holds that field, the stone is spent instead and the field stands. The lift comes before that art's hit, so the mist it lifts cannot make it miss.
The Wind Lifts the Mist.approx: engine.py fires events on resolution (was_hit/evaded) rather than pre-roll, and decoy_struck drops element; reacts to wind-element art hits/evades once per pulse in reverse priority (road_mist -> mist_field -> lantern_stone) without retroactively re-rolling that strike.

Thin as Glass.rule: Glass Storm, full set: while you are above half health, each Lightning crit chains one more bolt. Each time a single hit takes more than a tenth of your health, your next Lightning art fires at once. Healing on you is 20 % weaker, because the glass does not mend.
Thin as Glass.approx: Uses always heal_taken -20 (only heal_taken, never double-penalized with healing); Lightning crits above 50 % HP trigger free_hit c: 0.45 dtype: lightning; because engine own.lost_last.hp.1 returns raw HP (not a share of hp_max) and event.amount is raw HP, heavy single hits (>10 % HP) are approximated by enemy art crits (was_hit filter kind: art, is_crit: true, cooldown 2 s) advancing own next art timer.

Thorns.rule: A blocked hit returns 30 % of the blocked amount to the attacker as physical damage, once per pulse.
Thorns.engine_choice: the returned damage meets the attacker's defence

Thousand Talismans.rule: The talismans you draw before a fight cost no stock for their first two uses. Closes: arts that are not talismans deal 30 % less.
Thousand Talismans.pending: talisman stock: the rule switches on with the Talismans GDD (the closing runs now)

Thread of the Nest.rule: Nest-Thread Banner (pm-nest-thread-banner): While the holder's array (a Field) is up, the holder takes 10 % less Fire damage and the holder's wards last a second longer.
Thread of the Nest.approx: longer ward duration modelled as +10 % main ward strength while own.field_up >= 1

Tide.rule: Your Water damage rises and falls in a 6-pulse cycle: L5 +0 to +20.

Toll Taker.rule: When the enemy pays art cost that your Ice stacks added, you restore linh luc equal to 10 % of that extra cost.

Toll for the Dead.rule: When the foe is Broken or you are first Wounded, your slotted arts come ready (not sooner than cooldown_min) and your next soul art deals +30 % soul damage.
Toll for the Dead.approx: Uses timer which='all' by=-999 because timer cannot filter to dtype 'soul' only; the +30 % x_soul charge still consumes only on a soul art firing.

Toll of the Frozen Bolt.rule: Bell of the Frozen Bolt (authored wish a1): every fifth Winter Toll Canon art you cast rings the bell: the foe gains 2 Ice stacks (8 s), and its clock stops for 0.5 s so arts coming ready in that half-second wait until it ends.

Touchstone.rule: Hallmark Seal (ck-hallmark-seal, d38): once per art firing, your first hit on a foe that holds buff stacks strips one of them (its largest pile, oldest batch first).

Tried and Stamped.rule: Assayer's Tools, full set (3 pieces: ck-hundred-fold-crucible, ck-hallmark-seal, ck-refiner-robe): a foe your art hits while it carries a buff is stamped for 6 s; the next buff it gains burns off at once, and you gain a ward worth 5 % of your health.
Tried and Stamped.approx: the engine has no foe buff_gained event, so the 6 s stamp checks foe.buff_elements >= 1 on each pulse and consumes the stamp on burn; strip does not report exact stack count, so touchstone_stripped counts 1 per burn

True Gold Does Not Fear the Furnace.rule: True Gold Does Not Fear the Furnace (Chân Kim Bất Phạ Hỏa, true-gold-canon L4 passive art, d31): each buff stack you strip from the foe, and each ward share your Assay strips, restores 1.5 % of your maximum linh lực and adds one Part the Dross stack (4 s).
True Gold Does Not Fear the Furnace.approx: the engine's strip action does not report exact stack count removed, so multi-stack strips (The Furnace Shows, Tried and Stamped) count 1 trigger per strip event rather than 1 per stack

True Gold Shows.rule: Assayer's Touchstone: you know the grade of any item you hold or are offered, and whether it is a forgery. A trade and appraisal rule (Item Database and the market), not a fight rule.
True Gold Shows.not_run: out of fight: an appraisal rule for the market and item screens, no fight record

True Line.rule: Plumb and Level, full set: while the foe carries your Metal stacks, your hits cannot miss (accuracy +100; the engine reads accuracy without the hit's context, so it is all your hits, not only sword arts). Every fifth sword hit in a row (sword-tagged art hits that land; another art's hit breaks the row, the basic attack does not) sends one of the Hundred Swords down the same line at no cost: a free Physical hit of 0.6, a Flying Blade's strike.
True Line.approx: accuracy is all your hits; the Hundred Swords' blade is a free hit of 0.6

True to the Line.rule: Square-and-Compass Flag: your Stele charges last 3 s longer (15 s, not 12). Stele charges are never worn by foe hits in the engine, so the "not worn" half needs nothing. Anchor charges are not in this pass (no Thiên Xu record grants one).

Tuned Bronze.rule: Seal of the Listening Bell (passive art, layer 4): your bells and wards resist soul (+15 % soul resistance) and charm (+20 % status resistance against Charmed) arts; each soul art that lands on you or charm art you evade or stop rings and slows its caster (1 Slowed Time stack for 3 s, and +0.5 s delay on their next art).
Tuned Bronze.approx: Always grants soul_res 15 and status_resist 20 (status: charmed); rings and slows the foe on soul_taken, or on evaded / hit_stopped with tag charm.

Turn the Herd.rule: Cloud-Herding Lance: when your companion's hit lands within 1 s of one of your art hits, the foe's soonest art waits 0.3 s and your companion's next hit deals 30 % more.

Twin Plums.rule: Red and White Plums, full set: your Snow Plum cuts alternate swords. Every fifth Snow Plum hit that lands strikes again (a Cold hit of 0.36, one petal's share), and a Snow Plum hit that crits lays one more Ice stack.

Two Wings Beat.rule: Twin Wings, full set (2 pieces): fan arts alternate wings; every third fan art throws its feathers twice.

Under the Lid.rule: Canopy and Lid, full set (2 pieces): while a foe carries both your Earth and your Mercury stacks, your stance ward regains 3 % of its peak each second, and each fan art (tags fan or fan-gust) lays 1 more Mercury stack (8 s) on the foe.

Under the Umbrella.rule: Spotted-Bamboo Umbrella: While the umbrella is open, the first Lightning hit each 10 s that would strike you runs off its rim instead, and you gain linh lực equal to a tenth of the damage it would have dealt.
Under the Umbrella.approx: On was_hit (dtype: lightning) once per 10 s cooldown, heals back 100 % of ev.amount (ignoring heal_taken modifiers) and restores 10 % as linh lực; marks umbrella_open = 1 at fight_start for The Rain Answers.

Unlit.rule: The Cold Furnace (Lãnh Lô): until it is lit the furnace gives only its modifiers. It lights itself the first time the holder's health falls to 40 % or below: for 10 s his healing over time is doubled, and he loses 10 % of his maximum health (waived while Haze Held All Night is active via dusk_no_lit_cost).

Unmaking Glass.rule: Each hit you land strips 1 buff stack from the target, from its largest pile, at most once a pulse; each stack stripped counts as a status you landed. Closes: your own buff stacks last 25 % shorter.

Unmoved Stance.rule: The art-speed and basic-speed penalties of your stances do not apply to you. Closes: your evade is 0 while a stance is on.

Until It Stops Wanting.rule: Pear-Blossom Vigil, full set (3 pieces): each Winter Toll Canon art you cast while the foe is held by your Frost Seal (seal_hold, Heavy Breath, or Slowed Time) makes the seal hold last 1 s longer, and reduces damage the foe deals by 5 % (dampen_taken 5.26) for 10 s; the tolls stack with no ceiling, and each fades on its own.

Unyielding Breath.rule: Once a fight, a blow that would put you Down leaves you at 1 health. Closes: maximum health -15 %.

Utmost Yang.rule: Your hits deal L5 +6 for each different base element among your slotted arts, cap +30. Closes: your wards are 30 % weaker.

Utmost Yin.rule: You resist 6 more for each different base element among your slotted arts, cap +30. Closes: your hits deal 20 % less.

Verdict Stands.rule: Your Thunder debuff stacks on a Slowed target cannot expire. Closes: Thunder stacks you lay on a foe that is not Slowed last 25 % shorter.
Verdict Stands.approx: held from the first status landed while Slowed; the closing is not run

Voice in the Rain.rule: Rain over the Long Lake, full set: while your Pine Rain falls, each heal you receive also gives you one Water buff stack and restores 1 % of your maximum linh lực; heals on you below a third of your health are 25 % stronger.

Waits for Its Blade.rule: Empty Frost Scabbard: while Thanh Sương is worn with this scabbard, the scabbard rises to grade 4 (+5 % ward strength, +4 % status resistance, +30 Cold resistance) and Thanh Sương's cold modifiers wake for any holder (+20 % attack and +10 % art speed on non-Cold sword arts, and Frost on the Field wakes on sword hits).

Walk the Nodes.rule: Keeper of the Lid, full set (2 pieces): while your Field is up, every 6 s your stance ward regains 4 % of its peak and you gain an Earth guard stack (an Earth buff, 20 s). Once a fight, at 10 Earth buff stacks, your stance ward is held for 3 s (it stops hits but loses nothing).

Warm the Grove.rule: Seed-Warming Censer (1v1 rewrite of allies -> you): Wood buff stacks you lay last 25 % longer (+2 to 2.5 s on 8-10 s batches), and when you gain Wood buff stacks (once per pulse) you also gain 1 Fire buff stack for 6 s and +0.5 % max health regeneration per second for 6 s.

Water Begets Wood.rule: Your Water buff stacks also count as Wood buff stacks. Closes: Earth arts you slot deal 50 % less.

Water Table.rule: You gain 30 % of the linh luc the enemy's drain wards pay against your hits. Closes: your linh luc never regenerates in fights.

Water Wears the Stone.rule: Canon of the Good Rain (passive art, unlock layer 6, authored wish d24): each heal restored to you (at most 3 a pulse) drips on the foe as a free Physical hit of 0.15 + 0.01 per Wood buff stack you hold.
Water Wears the Stone.approx: free_hit carries dtype phys with no art tag param (d24 calls for a Physical hit tagged moc), and base 0.15 + 0.01*wood runs as two separate free_hit records because free_hit lacks base + per_stack scaling.

Weighed.rule: Weight of the Heavenly Balance: a foe hit by your seal art (a seal-tagged hit that lands) carries a Weight, an Earth stack for 6 s; with it the foe is cursed with Heavy Breath (its arts cost 25 % more, the engine's nearest to 20 %) for 6 s, which curses clamp to 5 s. The dialogue half (a lie told to you while it carries the Weight is known) is not a fight rule: NPC Interaction & Dialogue's.
Weighed.approx: "arts cost 20 % more" is Heavy Breath (25 %), clamped to 5 s; the dialogue half is not run in a fight

What Hurts You, Wrap.rule: Moon over Pearl, full set (3 pieces): each foe art your ward absorbs lays 1 Nacre on the Fist Pearl; when the Fist Pearl spends its Nacre, your stance ward freezes unbreakable for 2 s (ward_fixed) and the next Cast the Pearl you fire lays 2 Ice stacks (8 s).

What the Chest Kept.rule: The Salt Chest (3 pieces): once a fight, when your linh lực falls below a quarter, the lock opens: you regain half your linh lực and gain a haze ward worth 10 % of your health.

Wheel in the Flag.rule: Your arts deal 5 % more for each element whose buff stacks you hold, up to five elements.

When the Thread Breaks.rule: When the Thread Breaks (Đoạn Ti, unbroken-thread-canon L3 passive art, d37): your Reel In thread on the foe breaks when the foe fires a heavy or slow art, costing 4 % of your maximum linh lực (the recoil, when you have it). A thread that runs its whole 5 s unbroken ties a Knot (no cap): each Knot makes your thread arts lay 1 more Wood stack and Burning Thread lay 2 more Fire stacks.

Whetstone Vow.rule: Art costs you pay in health are halved. Closes: you can never heal above 80 % of your maximum health.

Wildfire.rule: When one of your Burn batches runs out, half its stacks rekindle as a new batch for 2 pulses, once per batch.

Wind at Your Back.rule: When you evade, you gain 1 Wind buff stack for 4 s, at most 2 a pulse.

Wood Begets Fire.rule: Your Wood buff stacks also count as Fire buff stacks. Closes: Metal arts you slot deal 50 % less.

Words Before Blades.rule: Keeper of the Old Tower, full set: for the first 5 s of each fight you take 25 % less damage while you cast no damaging art; each hit you evade in that time stores one Water buff stack, and your first sword art after it spends them all for 8 % more damage each.
Words Before Blades.approx: Uses words_window (5 pulses at fight_start, cleared immediately on any damaging art_fired); while words_window >= 1, always grants dampen_taken: 33 (~24.8 % less damage, 1/1.33 = 0.752) and evades store 1 Water buff + words_evades. Next damaging sword art spends words_evades via 1 ms temp_mod dmg_more 0.08 scoped to kind: art, tags: [sword].

Words Before Needles.rule: Envoy's Credentials, full set: each attack you evade loads one needle into the fan, and each second in which you strike (fire a damaging or movement art; an evade alone is not a strike, though a ward or heal fired in the very instant of an evade reads as one) one needle falls out. Your next fan art (an art tagged needle, such as Needle Rain, or the fan's own Fan Gust, tagged artifact) throws them all: a free Physical hit of 0.1 per needle, no cap. Leaving the fight when you have struck no one is the Envoy's Jade Tally's rule (Envoys Are Not Struck), a piece of this set.
